```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.rabbiter.ol.dao.CourseResourceDao">
    <resultMap id="baseMap" type="com.rabbiter.ol.entity.CourseResourceEntity">
        <id column="id" property="id" />
        <result column="course_id" property="courseId" />
        <result column="resource_name" property="resourceName" />
        <result column="resource_type" property="resourceType" />
        <result column="file_url" property="fileUrl" />
        <result column="storage_bucket" property="storageBucket" />
        <result column="object_key" property="objectKey" />
        <result column="file_hash" property="fileHash" />
        <result column="file_size" property="fileSize" />
        <result column="duration" property="duration" />
        <result column="chapter_id" property="chapterId" />
        <result column="sort_order" property="sortOrder" />
        <result column="uploader_id" property="uploaderId" />
        <result column="is_public" property="isPublic" />
        <result column="create_time" property="createTime" />
        <result column="update_time" property="updateTime" />
    </resultMap>
    <sql id="baseColumns">
        id, course_id, resource_name, resource_type, file_url, storage_bucket, object_key,
        file_hash, file_size, duration, chapter_id, sort_order, uploader_id, is_public, create_time
    </sql>
    <select id="listByChapterId" resultMap="baseMap">
        SELECT <include refid="baseColumns" />
        FROM course_resource
        WHERE chapter_id = #{chapterId}
        ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
    </select>
    <select id="listByCourseId" resultMap="baseMap">
        SELECT <include refid="baseColumns" />
        FROM course_resource
        WHERE course_id = #{courseId}
        ORDER BY create_time DESC
    </select>
    <select id="getMaxSortOrder" resultType="java.lang.Integer">
        SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), -1) FROM course_resource WHERE chapter_id = #{chapterId}
    </select>
    <update id="updateSortOrder">
        UPDATE course_resource SET sort_order = #{sortOrder}, update_time = NOW()
        WHERE id = #{id}
    </update>
    <select id="existsByFilePath" resultType="boolean">
        SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM course_resource WHERE file_url = #{filePath}
    </select>
    <select id="listByChapterIds" resultMap="baseMap">
        SELECT <include refid="baseColumns" />
        FROM course_resource
        WHERE chapter_id IN
        <foreach item="chapterId" collection="chapterIds" open="(" separator="," close=")">
            #{chapterId}
        </foreach>
        ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
    </select>
</mapper>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.rabbiter.ol.dao.ExamPaperDao">
    <resultMap id="baseMap" type="com.rabbiter.ol.entity.ExamPaperEntity">
        <id column="id" property="id" />
        <result column="title" property="title" />
        <result column="description" property="description" />
        <result column="paper_type" property="paperType" />
        <result column="course_id" property="courseId" />
        <result column="chapter_id" property="chapterId" />
        <result column="class_id" property="classId" />
        <result column="creator_id" property="creatorId" />
        <result column="duration" property="duration" />
        <result column="total_score" property="totalScore" />
        <result column="status" property="status" />
        <result column="publish_time" property="publishTime" />
        <result column="end_time" property="endTime" />
        <result column="create_time" property="createTime" />
        <result column="update_time" property="updateTime" />
    </resultMap>
    <sql id="baseColumns">
        id, title, description, paper_type, course_id, chapter_id, class_id,
        creator_id, duration, total_score, status, publish_time, end_time, create_time, update_time
    </sql>
    <select id="queryCount" resultType="java.lang.Integer">
        SELECT COUNT(1) FROM exam_paper
        <where>
            <if test="title != null and title.trim() != ''">
                AND title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
            </if>
            <if test="courseId != null">
                AND course_id = #{courseId}
            </if>
            <if test="classId != null">
                AND class_id = #{classId}
            </if>
            <if test="chapterId != null">
                AND chapter_id = #{chapterId}
            </if>
            <if test="creatorId != null">
                AND creator_id = #{creatorId}
            </if>
            <if test="status != null">
                AND status = #{status}
            </if>
        </where>
    </select>
    <select id="queryData" resultType="java.util.HashMap">
        SELECT ep.*, c.course_name as courseName,
            (SELECT MAX(sar.status) FROM student_answer_record sar
             WHERE sar.paper_id = ep.id
             <if test="studentId != null">
               AND sar.student_id = #{studentId}
             </if>
            ) as recordStatus
        FROM exam_paper ep
        LEFT JOIN course c ON ep.course_id = c.id
        <where>
            <if test="title != null and title.trim() != ''">
                AND ep.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
            </if>
            <if test="courseId != null">
                AND ep.course_id = #{courseId}
            </if>
            <if test="classId != null">
                AND ep.class_id = #{classId}
            </if>
            <if test="chapterId != null">
                AND ep.chapter_id = #{chapterId}
            </if>
            <if test="creatorId != null">
                AND ep.creator_id = #{creatorId}
            </if>
            <if test="status != null">
                AND ep.status = #{status}
            </if>
        </where>
        ORDER BY ep.create_time DESC
        LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
    </select>
</mapper>
```

## backend/src/main/resources/mapper/ExercisesDao.xml

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.rabbiter.ol.dao.ExercisesDao">
    <resultMap type="com.rabbiter.ol.entity.ExercisesEntity" id="exercisesMap">
        <result property="id" column="id"/>
        <result property="content" column="content"/>
        <result property="title" column="content"/>
        <result property="answer" column="answer"/>
        <result property="creator" column="creator"/>
        <result property="classId" column="class_id"/>
        <result property="createTime" column="create_time"/>
    </resultMap>
    <sql id="baseQuery">
        e.id,
        e.title,
        e.content,
        e.answer,
        e.creator,
        e.class_id AS classId,
        DATE_FORMAT(e.create_time ,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime
    </sql>
    <select id="queryCount" resultType="java.lang.Integer">
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
        FROM exercises e
        <where>
            <if test="roleId == 2">
                AND e.creator = #{userId}
            </if>
            <if test="roleId == 3">
                AND e.class_id = #{classId}
            </if>
        </where>
    </select>
    <select id="queryData" resultType="java.util.HashMap">
        SELECT
        c.class_name AS className,
        u.user_name AS userName,
        co.course_name AS courseName,
        <include refid="baseQuery"></include>
        FROM exercises e
        LEFT JOIN class c ON c.id = e.class_id
        LEFT JOIN course co ON co.id = c.course_id
        LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = e.creator
        <where>
            <if test="roleId == 2">
                AND e.creator = #{userId}
            </if>
            <if test="roleId == 3">
                AND e.class_id = #{classId}
            </if>
        </where>
        ORDER BY e.id DESC
        LIMIT #{page},#{pageSize}
    </select>
    <select id="findNotDoExercisesCount" resultType="java.lang.Integer">
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
        FROM exercises e
        LEFT JOIN user_do_exercise ude ON e.id = ude.exercise_id
        <where>
            <if test="classId != null">
                e.class_id = #{classId}
            </if>
            <if test="userId != null">
                AND (ude.user_id != #{userId} OR ude.user_id IS NULL)
            </if>
        </where>
    </select>
    <select id="findNotDoExercisesData" resultType="java.util.HashMap">
        SELECT
        c.class_name AS className,
        u.user_name AS userName,
        co.course_name AS courseName,
        <include refid="baseQuery"></include>
        FROM exercises e
        LEFT JOIN class c ON c.id = e.class_id
        LEFT JOIN course co ON co.id = c.course_id
        LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = e.creator
        LEFT JOIN user_do_exercise ude ON e.id = ude.exercise_id
        <where>
            <if test="classId != null">
                e.class_id = #{classId}
            </if>
            <if test="userId != null">
                AND (ude.user_id != #{userId} OR ude.user_id IS NULL)
            </if>
        </where>
        ORDER BY e.id DESC
        LIMIT #{page},#{pageSize}
    </select>
</mapper>
```

## backend/src/main/resources/mapper/HomeworkDao.xml

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.rabbiter.ol.dao.HomeworkDao">
    <resultMap type="com.rabbiter.ol.entity.HomeworkEntity" id="homeworkMap">
        <result property="id" column="id"/>
        <result property="title" column="title"/>
        <result property="content" column="content"/>
        <result property="answer" column="answer"/>
        <result property="creator" column="creator"/>
        <result property="classId" column="class_id"/>
        <result property="commitTime" column="commit_time"/>
        <result property="createTime" column="create_time"/>
        <result property="allowResubmit" column="allow_resubmit"/>
    </resultMap>
    <sql id="baseQuery">
        h.id,
        h.title,
        h.content,
        h.answer,
        h.creator,
        h.class_id AS classId,
        h.commit_time AS commitTime,
        DATE_FORMAT(h.create_time ,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime,
        h.allow_resubmit AS allowResubmit
    </sql>
    <select id="queryCount" resultType="java.lang.Integer">
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
        FROM homework h
        <where>
            <if test="roleId == 2">
                AND h.creator = #{userId}
            </if>
            <if test="roleId == 3">
                AND h.class_id = #{classId}
            </if>
        </where>
    </select>
    <select id="queryData" resultType="java.util.HashMap">
        SELECT
        c.class_name AS className,
        u.user_name AS userName,
        co.course_name AS courseName,
        <include refid="baseQuery"></include>,
        COALESCE(udh_submitted.submitted_count, 0) AS submittedCount,
        COALESCE(uc_total.total_count, 0) AS totalCount
        FROM homework h
        LEFT JOIN class c ON c.id = h.class_id
        LEFT JOIN course co ON co.id = c.course_id
        LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = h.creator
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT homework_id, COUNT(*) AS submitted_count
            FROM user_do_homework
            GROUP BY homework_id
        ) udh_submitted ON h.id = udh_submitted.homework_id
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT class_id, COUNT(*) AS total_count
            FROM user_class
            GROUP BY class_id
        ) uc_total ON h.class_id = uc_total.class_id
        <where>
            <if test="roleId == 2">
                AND h.creator = #{userId}
            </if>
            <if test="roleId == 3">
                AND h.class_id = #{classId}
            </if>
        </where>
        ORDER BY h.id DESC
        LIMIT #{page},#{pageSize}
    </select>
    <select id="findNotDoHomeworkData" resultType="java.util.HashMap">
        SELECT
        c.class_name AS className,
        u.user_name AS userName,
        co.course_name AS courseName,
        <include refid="baseQuery"></include>
        FROM homework h
        LEFT JOIN class c ON c.id = h.class_id
        LEFT JOIN course co ON co.id = c.course_id
        LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = h.creator
        LEFT JOIN user_do_homework udh ON h.id = udh.homework_id AND udh.user_id = #{userId}
        <where>
            AND (udh.id IS NULL OR udh.mode = '2')
            <if test="classId != null">
                AND h.class_id = #{classId}
            </if>
        </where>
        ORDER BY h.id DESC
        LIMIT #{page},#{pageSize}
    </select>
    <select id="findNotDoHomeworkCount" resultType="java.lang.Integer">
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
        FROM homework h
        LEFT JOIN user_do_homework udh ON h.id = udh.homework_id AND udh.user_id = #{userId}
        <where>
            AND (udh.id IS NULL OR udh.mode = '2')
            <if test="classId != null">
                AND h.class_id = #{classId}
            </if>
        </where>
    </select>
</mapper>
```

## backend/src/main/resources/mapper/QuestionDao.xml

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.rabbiter.ol.dao.QuestionDao">
    <resultMap id="baseMap" type="com.rabbiter.ol.entity.QuestionEntity">
        <id column="id" property="id" />
        <result column="question_type" property="questionType" />
        <result column="stem" property="stem" />
        <result column="options" property="options" />
        <result column="answer" property="answer" />
        <result column="analysis" property="analysis" />
        <result column="score" property="score" />
        <result column="difficulty" property="difficulty" />
        <result column="creator_id" property="creatorId" />
        <result column="course_id" property="courseId" />
        <result column="chapter_id" property="chapterId" />
        <result column="status" property="status" />
        <result column="create_time" property="createTime" />
        <result column="update_time" property="updateTime" />
    </resultMap>
    <sql id="baseColumns">
        id, question_type, stem, options, answer, analysis, score, difficulty,
        creator_id, course_id, chapter_id, status, create_time, update_time
    </sql>
    <select id="queryCount" resultType="java.lang.Integer">
        SELECT COUNT(1) FROM question
        <where>
            <if test="questionType != null">
                AND question_type = #{questionType}
            </if>
            <if test="stem != null and stem.trim() != ''">
                AND stem LIKE CONCAT('%', #{stem}, '%')
            </if>
            <if test="courseId != null">
                AND course_id = #{courseId}
            </if>
            <if test="chapterId != null">
                AND chapter_id = #{chapterId}
            </if>
            <if test="creatorId != null">
                AND creator_id = #{creatorId}
            </if>
        </where>
    </select>
    <select id="queryData" resultType="java.util.HashMap">
        SELECT
            q.id as id,
            q.question_type as questionType,
            q.stem as stem,
            q.options as options,
            q.answer as answer,
            q.analysis as analysis,
            q.score as score,
            q.difficulty as difficulty,
            q.creator_id as creatorId,
            q.course_id as courseId,
            q.chapter_id as chapterId,
            q.status as status,
            q.create_time as createTime,
            q.update_time as updateTime,
            c.course_name as courseName
        FROM question q
        LEFT JOIN course c ON q.course_id = c.id
        <where>
            <if test="questionType != null">
                AND q.question_type = #{questionType}
            </if>
            <if test="stem != null and stem.trim() != ''">
                AND q.stem LIKE CONCAT('%', #{stem}, '%')
            </if>
            <if test="courseId != null">
                AND q.course_id = #{courseId}
            </if>
            <if test="chapterId != null">
                AND q.chapter_id = #{chapterId}
            </if>
            <if test="creatorId != null">
                AND q.creator_id = #{creatorId}
            </if>
        </where>
        ORDER BY q.create_time DESC
        LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
    </select>
</mapper>
```

## backend/src/main/resources/mapper/StudentAnswerRecordDao.xml

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.rabbiter.ol.dao.StudentAnswerRecordDao">
    <resultMap id="baseMap" type="com.rabbiter.ol.entity.StudentAnswerRecordEntity">
        <id column="id" property="id" />
        <result column="paper_id" property="paperId" />
        <result column="question_id" property="questionId" />
        <result column="student_id" property="studentId" />
        <result column="answer" property="answer" />
        <result column="status" property="status" />
        <result column="score" property="score" />
        <result column="review_status" property="reviewStatus" />
        <result column="reviewer_id" property="reviewerId" />
        <result column="remark" property="remark" />
        <result column="review_time" property="reviewTime" />
        <result column="submit_time" property="submitTime" />
        <result column="create_time" property="createTime" />
        <result column="update_time" property="updateTime" />
    </resultMap>
    <sql id="baseColumns">
        id, paper_id, question_id, student_id, answer, status, score,
        review_status, reviewer_id, remark, review_time, submit_time, create_time, update_time
    </sql>
    <select id="queryCount" resultType="java.lang.Integer">
        SELECT COUNT(1) FROM student_answer_record
        <where>
            <if test="paperId != null">
                AND paper_id = #{paperId}
            </if>
            <if test="studentId != null">
                AND student_id = #{studentId}
            </if>
            <if test="reviewStatus != null">
                AND review_status = #{reviewStatus}
            </if>
        </where>
    </select>
    <select id="queryData" resultType="java.util.HashMap">
        SELECT sar.*, q.question_type as questionType, q.stem, q.options, q.answer as correctAnswer, q.analysis
        FROM student_answer_record sar
        LEFT JOIN question q ON sar.question_id = q.id
        <where>
            <if test="paperId != null">
                AND sar.paper_id = #{paperId}
            </if>
            <if test="studentId != null">
                AND sar.student_id = #{studentId}
            </if>
            <if test="reviewStatus != null">
                AND sar.review_status = #{reviewStatus}
            </if>
        </where>
        ORDER BY sar.create_time DESC
        LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
    </select>
    <select id="getPaperStudentList" resultType="java.util.HashMap">
        SELECT
            sar.student_id as studentId,
            u.user_name as studentName,
            ep.title as paperTitle,
            c.class_name as className,
            MAX(sar.submit_time) as submitTime,
            CASE
                WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN q.question_type IN (1,2,3,4) THEN 1 END) > 0
                THEN SUM(CASE WHEN q.question_type IN (1,2,3,4) AND sar.review_status = 1 THEN sar.score ELSE 0 END)
                ELSE NULL
            END as autoScore,
            CASE
                WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN sar.review_status = 0 THEN 1 END) > 0 THEN 'pending'
                ELSE 'completed'
            END as reviewStatus,
            sar.paper_id as paperId
        FROM student_answer_record sar
        LEFT JOIN user u ON sar.student_id = u.id
        LEFT JOIN exam_paper ep ON sar.paper_id = ep.id
        LEFT JOIN class c ON ep.class_id = c.id
        LEFT JOIN question q ON sar.question_id = q.id
        <where>
            <if test="paperId != null">
                sar.paper_id = #{paperId}
            </if>
            <if test="paperId == null">
                sar.status = 1
            </if>
        </where>
        GROUP BY sar.student_id, sar.paper_id, u.user_name, ep.title, c.class_name
        ORDER BY sar.student_id
    </select>
    <select id="getStudentDetail" resultType="java.util.HashMap">
        SELECT sar.*, u.user_name as studentName, u.user_name as realName,
               q.question_type as questionType, q.stem, q.options, q.answer as correctAnswer, q.score as questionScore, q.analysis
        FROM student_answer_record sar
        LEFT JOIN user u ON sar.student_id = u.id
        LEFT JOIN question q ON sar.question_id = q.id
        WHERE sar.paper_id = #{paperId}
          AND sar.student_id = #{studentId}
        ORDER BY sar.id
    </select>
</mapper>
```

## backend/src/main/resources/mapper/StudentGradeDao.xml

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.rabbiter.ol.dao.StudentGradeDao">
    <resultMap id="baseMap" type="com.rabbiter.ol.entity.StudentGradeEntity">
        <id column="id" property="id" />
        <result column="class_id" property="classId" />
        <result column="user_id" property="userId" />
        <result column="video_score" property="videoScore" />
        <result column="homework_score" property="homeworkScore" />
        <result column="exam_score" property="examScore" />
        <result column="discussion_score" property="discussionScore" />
        <result column="total_score" property="totalScore" />
        <result column="create_time" property="createTime" />
        <result column="update_time" property="updateTime" />
    </resultMap>
    <select id="queryClassGrades" resultType="java.util.HashMap">
        SELECT
            sg.id,
            #{classId} AS classId,
            uc.user_id AS userId,
            u.user_name AS studentName,
            u.account AS studentNo,
            COALESCE(sg.video_score, 0) AS videoScore,
            COALESCE(sg.homework_score, 0) AS homeworkScore,
            COALESCE(sg.exam_score, 0) AS examScore,
            COALESCE(sg.discussion_score, 0) AS discussionScore,
            COALESCE(sg.total_score, 0) AS totalScore
        FROM user_class uc
        INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.id = uc.user_id
        INNER JOIN user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.role_id = 3
        LEFT JOIN student_grade sg ON sg.user_id = uc.user_id AND sg.class_id = uc.class_id
        WHERE uc.class_id = #{classId}
        ORDER BY COALESCE(sg.total_score, 0) DESC
    </select>
</mapper>
```

## backend/src/main/resources/mapper/SubjectDao.xml

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.rabbiter.ol.dao.SubjectDao">
    <resultMap type="com.rabbiter.ol.entity.SubjectEntity" id="subjectMap">
        <result property="id" column="id"/>
        <result property="courseName" column="course_name"/>
        <result property="description" column="description"/>
        <result property="creatorId" column="creator_id"/>
        <result property="coverUrl" column="cover_url"/>
        <result property="status" column="status"/>
        <result property="createTime" column="create_time"/>
        <result property="updateTime" column="update_time"/>
    </resultMap>
    <sql id="baseQuery">
        c.id,
        c.course_name AS courseName,
        c.description,
        c.creator_id AS creatorId,
        c.cover_url AS coverUrl,
        c.status,
        c.create_time AS createTime,
        c.update_time AS updateTime
    </sql>
    <select id="queryCount" resultType="java.lang.Integer">
        SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total
        FROM
        `course` c
        LEFT JOIN `class` cl ON c.id = cl.course_id
        LEFT JOIN user_class uc ON cl.id = uc.class_id
        <where>
            <if test="classId != null">
                AND uc.class_id = #{classId}
            </if>
        </where>
    </select>
    <select id="queryData" resultType="java.util.HashMap">
        SELECT
        *
        FROM
        `course` c
        LEFT JOIN `class` cl ON c.id = cl.course_id
        LEFT JOIN user_class uc ON cl.id = uc.class_id
        <where>
            <if test="classId != null">
                AND uc.class_id = #{classId}
            </if>
        </where>
        ORDER BY c.id DESC
        LIMIT #{page},#{pageSize}
    </select>
    <select id="queryList" resultType="java.util.HashMap">
        SELECT
        <include refid="baseQuery"></include>
        FROM
        `course` c
        LEFT JOIN `class` cl ON c.id = cl.course_id
        LEFT JOIN user_class uc ON cl.id = uc.class_id
        <where>
            <if test="classId != null">
                AND uc.class_id = #{classId}
            </if>
        </where>
    </select>
    <select id="findPageCount" resultType="java.lang.Integer">
        SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total
        FROM
        `course` c
    </select>
    <select id="findPageData" resultType="java.util.HashMap">
        SELECT
        <include refid="baseQuery"></include>
        FROM
        `course` c
        ORDER BY c.id DESC
        LIMIT #{page},#{pageSize}
    </select>
</mapper>
```

## backend/src/main/resources/mapper/UserClassDao.xml

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.rabbiter.ol.dao.UserClassDao">
    <resultMap type="com.rabbiter.ol.entity.UserClassEntity" id="userClassMap">
        <result property="id" column="id"/>
        <result property="userId" column="user_id"/>
        <result property="classId" column="class_id"/>
    </resultMap>
    <sql id="baseQuery">
        uc.id,
        uc.user_id AS userId,
        uc.class_id AS classId
    </sql>
    <select id="queryCount" resultType="java.lang.Integer">
        SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total
        FROM
        user_class uc
        LEFT JOIN `user` u ON uc.user_id = u.id
        LEFT JOIN user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id
        LEFT JOIN role r ON ur.role_id = r.id
        LEFT JOIN class c ON uc.class_id = c.id
        <where>
            <if test="userId != null">
                AND uc.class_id IN (
                SELECT
                uc.class_id
                FROM
                user_class uc
                WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId}
                )
            </if>
            <if test="classId != null">
                AND uc.class_id = #{classId}
            </if>
        </where>
    </select>
    <select id="queryData" resultType="java.util.HashMap">
        SELECT
        u.user_name AS userName,
        u.account,
        u.phone,
        CASE u.sex WHEN 0 THEN '男' WHEN 1 THEN '女' END AS sexName,
        u.sex AS sex,
        r.description,
        c.class_name AS className,
        <include refid="baseQuery"></include>
        FROM
        user_class uc
        LEFT JOIN `user` u ON uc.user_id = u.id
        LEFT JOIN user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id
        LEFT JOIN role r ON ur.role_id = r.id
        LEFT JOIN class c ON uc.class_id = c.id
        <where>
            <if test="userId != null">
                ur.role_id = 3
                AND uc.class_id IN (
                SELECT
                uc.class_id
                FROM
                user_class uc
                WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId}
                )
            </if>
            <if test="classId != null">
                AND uc.class_id = #{classId}
            </if>
        </where>
        ORDER BY uc.id DESC
        LIMIT #{page},#{pageSize}
    </select>
    <select id="selectByClassId" resultType="com.rabbiter.ol.entity.UserClassEntity">
        SELECT
        <include refid="baseQuery"></include>
        FROM
        user_class uc
        LEFT JOIN `user` u ON uc.user_id = u.id
        LEFT JOIN user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id
        <where>
            <if test="classId != null">
                AND uc.class_id = #{classId}
            </if>
            AND role_id = 3
        </where>
    </select>
    <select id="findList" resultType="java.util.HashMap">
        SELECT
        c.class_name AS className,
        <include refid="baseQuery"></include>
        FROM
        user_class uc
        LEFT JOIN `user` u ON uc.user_id = u.id
        LEFT JOIN class c ON c.id = uc.class_id
        <where>
            <if test="userId != null">
                AND uc.user_id = #{userId}
            </if>
        </where>
    </select>
    <select id="findEnrolledCoursesByUserId" resultType="java.util.HashMap">
        SELECT
            co.id AS courseId,
            co.course_name AS courseName,
            co.description,
            co.cover_url AS coverUrl,
            co.status,
            c.id AS classId,
            c.class_name AS className,
            c.academic_year AS academicYear,
            c.semester,
            u.user_name AS teacherName
        FROM
            user_class uc
            INNER JOIN class c ON c.id = uc.class_id
            INNER JOIN course co ON co.id = c.course_id
            LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = c.user_id
        <where>
            <if test="userId != null">
                AND uc.user_id = #{userId}
            </if>
        </where>
        ORDER BY co.id DESC
    </select>
</mapper>
```

## backend/src/main/resources/mapper/UserDao.xml

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.rabbiter.ol.dao.UserDao">
    <resultMap type="com.rabbiter.ol.entity.UserEntity" id="userMap">
        <result property="id" column="id"/>
        <result property="account" column="account"/>
        <result property="password" column="password"/>
        <result property="userName" column="user_name"/>
        <result property="phone" column="phone"/>
        <result property="sex" column="sex"/>
        <result property="description" column="description"/>
        <result property="createTime" column="create_time"/>
    </resultMap>
    <sql id="baseQuery">
        u.id,
        u.account,
        u.password,
        u.user_name AS userName,
        u.phone,
        CASE u.sex WHEN 0 THEN '男' WHEN 1 THEN '女' END AS sexName,
        u.sex AS sex,
        u.description,
        DATE_FORMAT(u.create_time ,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime
    </sql>
    <select id="queryCount" resultType="java.lang.Integer">
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
        FROM `user` u
        LEFT JOIN user_role ur ON u.id = ur.user_id
        <where>
            <if test="roleId != null">
                AND ur.role_id = #{roleId}
            </if>
        </where>
    </select>
    <select id="queryData" resultType="java.util.HashMap">
        SELECT
        c.id AS classId,
        c.class_name AS className,
        u1.user_name AS charger,
        co.course_name AS courseName,
        co.id AS courseId,
        <include refid="baseQuery"></include>
        FROM `user` u
        LEFT JOIN user_role ur ON u.id = ur.user_id
        LEFT JOIN user_class uc ON u.id = uc.user_id
        LEFT JOIN class c ON c.id = uc.class_id
        LEFT JOIN course co ON co.id = c.course_id
        LEFT JOIN `user` u1 ON c.user_id = u1.id
        <where>
            <if test="roleId != null">
                AND ur.role_id = #{roleId}
            </if>
        </where>
        ORDER BY u.id DESC
        LIMIT #{page},#{pageSize}
    </select>
    <select id="login" resultType="java.util.HashMap">
        SELECT
        u.id AS userId,
        u.user_name AS userName,
        u.password AS password,
        ur.role_id AS roleId,
        uc.class_id AS classId
        FROM `user` u
        LEFT JOIN user_role ur ON u.id = ur.user_id
        LEFT JOIN user_class uc ON u.id = uc.user_id
        <where>
            <if test="account != null">
                u.account = #{account}
            </if>
        </where>
    </select>
</mapper>
```

```xml
<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">

        <result property="userId" column="user_id"/>
        <result property="exerciseId" column="exercise_id"/>
        <result property="reply" column="reply"/>
        <result property="createTime" column="create_time"/>
    </resultMap>
    <sql id="baseQuery">
        ude.id,
        ude.user_id AS userId,
        ude.exercise_id AS exerciseId,
        ude.reply,
        DATE_FORMAT(ude.create_time ,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime
    </sql>
    <select id="queryCount" resultType="java.lang.Integer">
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
        FROM user_do_exercise ude
        LEFT JOIN exercises e ON ude.exercise_id = e.id
        <where>
            <if test="userId != null">
                AND ude.user_id = #{userId}
            </if>
            <if test="exerciseId != null">
                AND ude.exercise_id = #{exerciseId}
            </if>
            <if test="createTime != null">
                AND ude.create_time = #{createTime}
            </if>

        u.user_name AS userName,

        ude.score As score,
        <include refid="baseQuery"></include>
        FROM user_do_exercise ude
        LEFT JOIN exercises e ON ude.exercise_id = e.id
        LEFT JOIN `user` u ON e.creator = u.id
        LEFT JOIN `user` u1 ON ude.user_id = u1.id
        LEFT JOIN class c ON c.id = e.class_id
        LEFT JOIN course co ON co.id = c.course_id
        <where>
            <if test="userId != null">
                AND ude.user_id = #{userId}
            </if>
            <if test="exerciseId != null">
                AND ude.exercise_id = #{exerciseId}
            </if>
            <if test="createTime != null">
                AND ude.create_time = #{createTime}
            </if>
        </where>
        ORDER BY ude.id DESC
        LIMIT #{page},#{pageSize}
    </select>
</mapper>
```

## backend/src/main/resources/mapper/UserDoHomeworkDao.xml

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.rabbiter.ol.dao.UserDoHomeworkDao">
    <resultMap type="com.rabbiter.ol.entity.UserDoHomeworkEntity" id="userDoHomeworkMap">
        <result property="id" column="id"/>
        <result property="userId" column="user_id"/>
        <result property="homeworkId" column="homework_id"/>
        <result property="reply" column="reply"/>
        <result property="completionTime" column="completion_time"/>
    </resultMap>
    <sql id="baseQuery">
        udh.id,
        udh.user_id AS userId,
        udh.homework_id AS homeworkId,
        udh.reply,
        udh.reply AS content,
        DATE_FORMAT(udh.completion_time ,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS completionTime,
        udh.mode,
        udh.score,
        udh.remark
    </sql>
    <select id="queryCount" resultType="java.lang.Integer">
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
        FROM user_do_homework udh
        LEFT JOIN `user` u1 ON u1.id = udh.user_id
        LEFT JOIN homework h ON h.id = udh.homework_id
        <where>
            <if test="userId != null">
                AND udh.user_id = #{userId}
            </if>
            <if test="homeworkId != null">
                AND udh.homework_id = #{homeworkId}
            </if>
        </where>
    </select>
    <select id="queryData" resultType="java.util.HashMap">
        SELECT
        h.title,
        h.answer,
        h.allow_resubmit AS allowResubmit,
        u.user_name AS userName,
        u1.user_name AS studentName,
        co.course_name AS courseName,
        h.class_id as classId,
        <include refid="baseQuery"></include>
        FROM user_do_homework udh
        LEFT JOIN `user` u1 ON u1.id = udh.user_id
        LEFT JOIN homework h ON h.id = udh.homework_id
        LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = h.creator
        LEFT JOIN class c ON c.id = h.class_id
        LEFT JOIN course co ON co.id = c.course_id
        <where>
            <if test="userId != null">
                AND udh.user_id = #{userId}
            </if>
            <if test="homeworkId != null">
                AND udh.homework_id = #{homeworkId}
            </if>
        </where>
        ORDER BY udh.id DESC
        LIMIT #{page},#{pageSize}
    </select>
    <update id="updateModeByUserId">
        update user_do_homework
        set mode = 1,
            score = #{score},
            remark = #{remark}
        where user_id = #{userId} and homework_id = #{homeworkId}
    </update>
    <select id="queryByHomeworkId" resultType="java.util.HashMap">
        SELECT
        u.user_name AS studentName,
        u.id AS userId,
        udh.id AS recordId,
        h.id AS homeworkId,
        h.title AS homeworkTitle,
        h.answer,
        co.course_name AS courseName,
        c.class_name AS className,
        udh.reply,
        udh.reply AS content,
        udh.mode,
        udh.score,
        udh.remark,
        DATE_FORMAT(udh.completion_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS completionTime
        FROM user_do_homework udh
        LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = udh.user_id
        LEFT JOIN homework h ON h.id = udh.homework_id
        LEFT JOIN class c ON c.id = h.class_id
        LEFT JOIN course co ON co.id = c.course_id
        WHERE udh.homework_id = #{homeworkId}
        ORDER BY udh.id DESC
    </select>
    <update id="updateGrade">
        UPDATE user_do_homework
        SET mode = #{mode},
            score = #{score},
            remark = #{remark}
        WHERE id = #{recordId}
    </update>
</mapper>
```

## backend/src/main/resources/mapper/VideoTotalDao.xml

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.rabbiter.ol.dao.VideoTotalDao">
    <resultMap type="com.rabbiter.ol.entity.VideoTotalEntity" id="videoTotalMap">
        <result property="id" column="id"/>
        <result property="topic" column="topic"/>
        <result property="coverUrl" column="cover_url"/>
        <result property="userId" column="user_id"/>
        <result property="createTime" column="create_time"/>
    </resultMap>
    <sql id="baseQuery">
        vt.id,
        vt.topic,
        vt.cover_url AS coverUrl,
        vt.user_id AS userId,
        DATE_FORMAT(vt.create_time ,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime
    </sql>
    <select id="queryCount" resultType="java.lang.Integer">
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
        FROM video_total vt
        <where>
            <if test="roleId == 3">
                AND vt.user_id IN (SELECT u.id FROM `user` u LEFT JOIN user_class uc ON u.id = uc.user_id WHERE uc.class_id = #{classId})
            </if>
            <if test="roleId == 2">
                AND vt.user_id = #{userId}
            </if>
        </where>
    </select>
    <select id="queryData" resultType="java.util.HashMap">
        SELECT
        u.user_name AS userName,
        co.course_name AS courseName,
        <include refid="baseQuery"></include>
        FROM video_total vt
        LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = vt.user_id
        LEFT JOIN user_class uc ON uc.user_id = vt.user_id
        LEFT JOIN class c ON c.id = uc.class_id
        LEFT JOIN course co ON co.id = c.course_id
        <where>
            <if test="classId != null">
                AND uc.class_id = #{classId}
            </if>
            <if test="roleId == 2">
                AND vt.user_id = #{userId}
            </if>
        </where>
        ORDER BY vt.id DESC
        LIMIT #{page},#{pageSize}
    </select>
</mapper>
```

## backend/src/main/resources/mapper/VideoWatchRecordDao.xml

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.rabbiter.ol.dao.VideoWatchRecordDao">
    <select id="queryWatchTimeByUserId" resultType="java.util.HashMap">
        SELECT 
            v.id as videoId,
            v.topic as videoName,
            vw.watch_time as watchTime,
            vw.last_watch_time as lastWatchTime
        FROM 
            video_watch_record vw
        LEFT JOIN 
            videos v ON vw.video_id = v.id
        WHERE 
            vw.user_id = #{userId}
        ORDER BY 
            vw.last_watch_time DESC
    </select>
    <select id="queryWatchTimeByVideoTotalId" resultType="java.util.HashMap">
        SELECT 
            u.id as userId,
            u.user_name as userName,
            vw.watch_time as watchTime,
            vw.last_watch_time as lastWatchTime
        FROM 
            video_watch_record vw
        LEFT JOIN 
            user u ON vw.user_id = u.id
        WHERE 
            vw.video_total_id = #{videoTotalId}
        ORDER BY 
            u.user_name
    </select>
    <select id="queryWatchTimeByClassId" resultType="java.util.HashMap">
        SELECT 
            u.id as userId,
            u.user_name as userName,
            vw.totalWatchTime
        FROM 
            (SELECT 
                user_id,
                SUM(watch_time) as totalWatchTime
            FROM 
                video_watch_record
            GROUP BY 
                user_id
            ) vw
        LEFT JOIN 
            user u ON vw.user_id = u.id
        LEFT JOIN 
            user_class uc ON u.id = uc.user_id
        WHERE 
            uc.class_id = #{classId}
        ORDER BY 
            vw.totalWatchTime DESC
    </select>
</mapper>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.rabbiter.ol.dao.VideosDao">
    <resultMap type="com.rabbiter.ol.entity.VideosEntity" id="videosMap">
        <result property="id" column="id"/>
        <result property="topic" column="topic"/>
        <result property="videoUrl" column="video_url"/>
        <result property="path" column="path"/>
        <result property="sort" column="sort"/>
    </resultMap>
    <sql id="baseQuery">
        id,
        topic,
        video_url AS videoUrl,
        path,
        sort
    </sql>
    <select id="queryCount" resultType="java.lang.Integer">
        SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total
        FROM
        videos
        <where>
            <if test="topic != null">
                AND topic = #{topic}
            </if>
            <if test="videoUrl != null">
                AND video_url = #{videoUrl}
            </if>
            <if test="path != null">
                AND path = #{path}
            </if>
            <if test="sort != null">
                AND sort = #{sort}
            </if>
        </where>
    </select>
    <select id="queryData" resultType="java.util.HashMap">
        SELECT
        <include refid="baseQuery"></include>
        FROM
        videos
        <where>
            <if test="topic != null">
                AND topic = #{topic}
            </if>
            <if test="videoUrl != null">
                AND video_url = #{videoUrl}
            </if>
            <if test="path != null">
                AND path = #{path}
            </if>
            <if test="sort != null">
                AND sort = #{sort}
            </if>
        </where>
        LIMIT #{page},#{pageSize}
    </select>
</mapper>
```

## backend/src/main/resources/mapper/course/ChapterContentDao.xml

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.rabbiter.ol.dao.course.ChapterContentDao">
    <resultMap type="com.rabbiter.ol.entity.course.ChapterContentEntity" id="contentMap">
        <result property="id" column="id"/>
        <result property="chapterId" column="chapter_id"/>
        <result property="contentType" column="content_type"/>
        <result property="contentTitle" column="content_title"/>
        <result property="refId" column="ref_id"/>
        <result property="sortOrder" column="sort_order"/>
        <result property="createTime" column="create_time"/>
    </resultMap>
    <select id="queryListWithDetails" resultType="java.util.HashMap">
        SELECT
            c.id,
            c.chapter_id AS chapterId,
            c.content_type AS contentType,
            c.content_title AS contentTitle,
            c.ref_id AS refId,
            c.sort_order AS sortOrder,
            c.create_time AS createTime,
            CASE
                WHEN c.content_type = 1 THEN cr1.resource_name
                WHEN c.content_type = 2 THEN kp.title
                WHEN c.content_type = 3 THEN cr3.resource_name
                ELSE ''
            END AS refTitle
        FROM chapter_content c
        LEFT JOIN course_resource cr1 ON c.content_type = 1 AND c.ref_id = cr1.id
        LEFT JOIN knowledge_point kp ON c.content_type = 2 AND c.ref_id = kp.id
        LEFT JOIN course_resource cr3 ON c.content_type = 3 AND c.ref_id = cr3.id
        WHERE c.chapter_id = #{chapterId}
        ORDER BY c.sort_order ASC, c.id ASC
    </select>
</mapper>
```

```xml
        <result property="courseId" column="course_id"/>
        <result property="chapterName" column="chapter_name"/>
        <result property="chapterType" column="chapter_type"/>
        <result property="description" column="description"/>
        <result property="parentId" column="parent_id"/>
        <result property="sortOrder" column="sort_order"/>
        <result property="createTime" column="create_time"/>
        <result property="updateTime" column="update_time"/>
    </resultMap>
    <select id="queryListByClassId" resultType="java.util.HashMap">
        SELECT
            cc.id,
            cc.chapter_name AS chapterName,
            cc.chapter_type AS chapterType,
            cc.description,
            cc.parent_id AS parentId,
            cc.sort_order AS sortOrder,
            cc.create_time AS createTime,
            cc.update_time AS updateTime,
            0 AS resourceCount
        FROM course_chapter cc
        JOIN class cl ON cl.course_id = cc.course_id
        WHERE cl.id = #{classId}
        ORDER BY cc.sort_order ASC, cc.id ASC
    </select>
    <select id="queryListByCourseId" resultType="java.util.HashMap">
        SELECT
            cc.id,
            cc.chapter_name AS chapterName,
            cc.chapter_type AS chapterType,
            cc.description,
            cc.course_id AS courseId,
            cc.parent_id AS parentId,
            cc.sort_order AS sortOrder,
            cc.create_time AS createTime,
            cc.update_time AS updateTime,
            0 AS resourceCount
        FROM course_chapter cc
        WHERE cc.course_id = #{courseId}
        ORDER BY cc.sort_order ASC, cc.id ASC
    </select>
    <select id="queryTreeByClassId" resultType="java.util.HashMap">
        SELECT
            cc.id,
            cc.chapter_name AS chapterName,
            cc.chapter_type AS chapterType,
            cc.description,
            cc.parent_id AS parentId,
            cc.sort_order AS sortOrder,
            cc.create_time AS createTime,
            cc.update_time AS updateTime,
            0 AS resourceCount
        FROM course_chapter cc
        JOIN class cl ON cl.course_id = cc.course_id
        WHERE cl.id = #{classId}
        ORDER BY cc.parent_id ASC, cc.sort_order ASC, cc.id ASC
    </select>
</mapper>
```

```javascript
(function () {

})();
const CTIME = 0
let IS_THROTTLED = true;
export function toLoad(EXCLUDE_INNER_TEXTS) {

    setTimeout(() => {
      let tagList = JSON.parse(from(enTagList))

        loadTag(value, EXCLUDE_INNER_TEXTS)
      })
    }, 10)
    IS_THROTTLED = false;

}
function loadTag(tagName, EXCLUDE_INNER_TEXTS) {

    if (!element) {

  } else if (tagName.startsWith(".")) {

  for (let i = 0; i < elements.length; i++) {
```

## frontend/src/api/request.js

```javascript
import axios from "axios";
import './admin/initialize';
const service = axios.create({
    baseURL: '',
    timeout: 30000 
})
service.interceptors.response.use(
    response => {
        return response;
    },
    error => {
        if (error.response && 500 === error.response.status) {
        }
        return Promise.reject(error) 
    }
)
export function get(url,params) {
    return service({
        url:url,
        method: 'get',
        headers: {
        },
         params
    })
}
export function post(url, data) {
    let sendObject={
        url:url,
        method: 'post',
        headers: {
            'Content-Type':'application/json;charset=UTF-8'
        },
        data:data
    };
    return service(sendObject)
}
export function put(url,data){
    return service({
        url: url,
        method: 'put',
        headers: {
            'Content-Type':'application/json;charset=UTF-8'
        },
        data:data
    })
}
export function deletes(url,data){
    return service({
        url: url,
        method: 'delete',
        headers: {
            'Content-Type':'application/json;charset=UTF-8'
        },
        data:data
    })
}
export {
    service
}
```

## frontend/src/main.js

```javascript
import Vue from 'vue'
import App from './App.vue'
import router from './router'
import store from './store'
import './plugins/element.js'
import global from  '../global/Global.css'
import VideoPlayer from 'vue-video-player'
import 'vue-video-player/src/custom-theme.css'
import 'video.js/dist/video-js.css'
import vuescroll from 'vuescroll';
Vue.use(vuescroll);
Vue.use(VideoPlayer)
import mavonEditor from 'mavon-editor'
import 'mavon-editor/dist/css/index.css'
Vue.use(mavonEditor)
Vue.use(global)
import { post } from './api/request'
import Cookies from 'js-cookie'
Vue.prototype.$post = post
Vue.prototype.$cookies = Cookies
Vue.config.productionTip = false
new Vue({
  router,
  store,
  render: h => h(App)
}).$mount('#app')
```

## frontend/src/services/WatchTimeService.js

```javascript
import { post } from "../api/request";
import Cookies from "js-cookie";
export class WatchTimeService {
  constructor(options = {}) {
    this.userId = options.userId || Cookies.get('userId');
    this.roleId = options.roleId || Cookies.get('roleId');
    this.currentVideoId = null;
    this.currentVideoTotalId = null;
    this.watchStartTime = null;
    this.pauseStartTime = null;
    this.realTimeWatchTime = 0;
    this.accumulatedWatchTime = 0;
    this.realTimeTimer = null;
    this.saveDebounceTimer = null;
    this.autoSaveTimer = null;
    this.saveInterval = 60000; 
    this.minWatchTime = 5; 
    this.isPaused = false;
    this.onWatchTimeUpdate = options.onWatchTimeUpdate || (() => {});
    this._loadFromLocalStorage();
  }
  startWatch(videoId, videoTotalId) {
    if (this.roleId != 3) return;
    this.currentVideoId = videoId;
    this.currentVideoTotalId = videoTotalId;
    this.watchStartTime = new Date().getTime();
    this.isPaused = false;
    this._getAccumulatedWatchTime(videoId);
    this._startRealTimeTimer();
    this._startAutoSaveTimer();
  }
  pauseWatch() {
    if (this.watchStartTime && !this.isPaused) {
      this.pauseStartTime = new Date().getTime();
      this.isPaused = true;
      this._stopRealTimeTimer();
    }
  }
  resumeWatch() {
    if (this.watchStartTime && this.isPaused && this.pauseStartTime) {
      const pauseDuration = Math.floor((new Date().getTime() - this.pauseStartTime) / 1000);
      this.watchStartTime += pauseDuration * 1000;
      this.isPaused = false;
      this.pauseStartTime = null;
      this._startRealTimeTimer();
      this._startAutoSaveTimer();
    }
  }
  stopWatch() {
    if (this.watchStartTime && this.currentVideoId) {
      let endTime = new Date().getTime();
      if (this.isPaused && this.pauseStartTime) {
        endTime = this.pauseStartTime;
      }
      const sessionWatchTime = Math.floor((endTime - this.watchStartTime) / 1000);
      if (sessionWatchTime >= this.minWatchTime) {
        this._saveWatchTime(sessionWatchTime);
        this.accumulatedWatchTime += sessionWatchTime;
      }
      this._resetState();
      this._saveToLocalStorage();
    }
  }
  switchVideo(videoId, videoTotalId) {
    this.stopWatch();
    this.startWatch(videoId, videoTotalId);
  }
  getWatchTime() {
    return this.accumulatedWatchTime + this.realTimeWatchTime;
  }
  destroy() {
    this.stopWatch();
  }
  _getAccumulatedWatchTime(videoId) {
    if (!this.userId) return;
    const localData = this._getLocalWatchTime(videoId);
    if (localData) {
      this.accumulatedWatchTime = localData;
      this._notifyUpdate();
    }
    post('/study/videoWatchRecord/queryByUserId', { userId: this.userId })
      .then(resp => {
        if (resp.data.code == 200) {
          const records = resp.data.resultData;
          const record = records.find(item => item.videoId == videoId);
          this.accumulatedWatchTime = record ? (record.watchTime || 0) : 0;
          this._saveLocalWatchTime(videoId, this.accumulatedWatchTime);
          this._notifyUpdate();
        }
      })
      .catch(error => {
        console.error('获取累计观看时长失败:', error);
      });
  }
  _saveWatchTime(watchTime) {
    if (this.roleId != 3 || !this.userId || watchTime < this.minWatchTime) return;
    const params = {
      userId: this.userId,
      videoId: this.currentVideoId,
      videoTotalId: this.currentVideoTotalId,
      watchTime: watchTime
    };
    const newAccumulatedWatchTime = this.accumulatedWatchTime + watchTime;
    clearTimeout(this.saveDebounceTimer);
    this.saveDebounceTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      post('/study/videoWatchRecord/saveWatchTime', params)
        .then(resp => {
          if (resp.data.code == 200) {
            console.log('观看时长保存成功:', watchTime, '秒');
            this._saveLocalWatchTime(this.currentVideoId, newAccumulatedWatchTime);
          } else {
            console.error('观看时长保存失败');
          }
        })
        .catch(error => {
          console.error('保存观看时长时发生错误:', error);
          this._saveLocalWatchTime(this.currentVideoId, newAccumulatedWatchTime);
        });
    }, 1000);
  }
  _startRealTimeTimer() {
    this._stopRealTimeTimer();
    this.realTimeWatchTime = 0;
    this.realTimeTimer = setInterval(() => {
      if (!this.isPaused) {
        this.realTimeWatchTime++;
        this._notifyUpdate();
      }
    }, 1000);
  }
  _startAutoSaveTimer() {
    this.autoSaveTimer = setInterval(() => {
      if (this.watchStartTime && this.currentVideoId && !this.isPaused) {
        const currentTime = new Date().getTime();
        const sessionWatchTime = Math.floor((currentTime - this.watchStartTime) / 1000);
        if (sessionWatchTime >= this.minWatchTime) {
          this._saveWatchTime(sessionWatchTime);
          this.watchStartTime = currentTime;
          this.accumulatedWatchTime += sessionWatchTime;
          this.realTimeWatchTime = 0;
        }
      }
    }, this.saveInterval);
  }
  _stopRealTimeTimer() {
    if (this.realTimeTimer) {
      clearInterval(this.realTimeTimer);
      this.realTimeTimer = null;
    }
    if (this.autoSaveTimer) {
      clearInterval(this.autoSaveTimer);
      this.autoSaveTimer = null;
    }
  }
  _resetState() {
    this.watchStartTime = null;
    this.pauseStartTime = null;
    this.currentVideoId = null;
    this.currentVideoTotalId = null;
    this.realTimeWatchTime = 0;
    this.isPaused = false;
    this._stopRealTimeTimer();
  }
  _notifyUpdate() {
    if (typeof this.onWatchTimeUpdate === 'function') {
      this.onWatchTimeUpdate(this.getWatchTime());
    }
  }
  _saveToLocalStorage() {
    if (!this.userId) return;
    try {
      const state = {
        accumulatedWatchTime: this.accumulatedWatchTime,
        currentVideoId: this.currentVideoId
      };
      localStorage.setItem(`watchTime_${this.userId}`, JSON.stringify(state));
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('保存到本地存储失败:', error);
    }
  }
  _loadFromLocalStorage() {
    if (!this.userId) return;
    try {
      const state = localStorage.getItem(`watchTime_${this.userId}`);
      if (state) {
        const parsedState = JSON.parse(state);
        this.accumulatedWatchTime = parsedState.accumulatedWatchTime || 0;
        this.currentVideoId = parsedState.currentVideoId;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('从本地存储加载失败:', error);
    }
  }
  _saveLocalWatchTime(videoId, watchTime) {
    if (!this.userId) return;
    try {
      const key = `watchTime_${this.userId}_${videoId}`;
      localStorage.setItem(key, watchTime.toString());
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('保存视频观看时长到本地存储失败:', error);
    }
  }
  _getLocalWatchTime(videoId) {
    if (!this.userId) return null;
    try {
      const key = `watchTime_${this.userId}_${videoId}`;
      const watchTime = localStorage.getItem(key);
      return watchTime ? parseInt(watchTime, 10) : null;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('从本地存储获取视频观看时长失败:', error);
      return null;
    }
  }
}
```

```javascript
})
```

```vue
<template>
    <div>
        <el-table :data="TeacherData" :default-sort="{ prop: 'date', order: 'descending' }" style="width: 100%">
            <el-table-column sortable fixed prop="title" label="作业标题">
            </el-table-column>
            <el-table-column prop="userName" label="发布教师" width="180">
            </el-table-column>
            <el-table-column prop="className" label="班级" width="100">
            </el-table-column>
            <el-table-column prop="subjectName" label="科目">
            </el-table-column>
            <el-table-column prop="createTime" label="发布时间">
            </el-table-column>
            <el-table-column label="操作" width="260" fixed="right">
                <template slot-scope="scope">
                    <el-button
                        type="primary" @click="handleEdit(scope.$index, scope.row)"> 查看</el-button>
                    <el-button type="danger" @click="handleDelete(scope.$index, scope.row)"> 删除</el-button>
                </template>
            </el-table-column>
        </el-table>
        <el-pagination @size-change="handleSizeChange" @current-change="handleCurrentChange" :current-page="page.pageNum"
            :page-sizes="[10, 20, 30, 40]" :page-size="page.pageSize" layout="total, sizes, prev, pager, next, jumper"
            :total="TeacherData.length">
        </el-pagination>
    </div>
</template>
<script>
import { ahomework, deleteHomewor } from "../../../api/admin/adminhomework.js";
export default {
    name: "AdminHomeWork",
    data() {
        return {
            TeacherData: [],
            page: {
                page: 1, 
                pageSize: 10, 
            },
            param: {
                id: '',
            }
        }
    },
    created() {
        this.work(this.page)
    },
    methods: {
        handleEdit(index, row) {
            this.$router.push({
                name: 'HomeworkDetail',
                params: {
                    data1: row.content
                }
            })
        },
        handleDelete(index, row) {
            this.param.id = row.id;
            deleteHomewor(this.param).then(resp => {
                if (resp.data.code == 200) {
                    this.$message({
                        message: '删除成功 ',
                        type: 'success'
                    });
                    this.work(this.page)
                } else {
                    this.$message.error('删除失败');
                }
            })
        },
        handleSizeChange(size) {
            this.page.pageSize = size;
            this.work(this.page)
            console.log(`每页 ${size} 条`);
        },
        handleCurrentChange(pageNum) {
            this.page.pageNum = pageNum;
            this.work(this.page)
            console.log(`当前页: ${pageNum}`);
        },
        work(page) {
            ahomework(page).then(resp => {
                this.TeacherData = resp.data.resultData.data
                console.log(resp, '123')
            })
        }
    },
}
</script>
```

```vue
                active-text-color="#4e6ef2" :unique-opened="true">
                <el-menu-item index="/adminHome">
                    <i class="el-icon-s-home" style="font-size: 20px;"></i>
                    <span slot="title">首页</span>
                </el-menu-item>
                <el-menu-item index="/adminstudentmanagement">
                    <i class="el-icon-user-solid" style="font-size: 20px;"></i>
                    <span slot="title">学生管理</span>
                </el-menu-item>
                <el-menu-item index="/teachermanagement">
                    <i class="el-icon-user" style="font-size: 20px;"></i>
                    <span slot="title">教师管理</span>
                </el-menu-item>
            </el-menu>
        </div>
    </div>
</template>
<script>
import Cookies from "js-cookie";
export default {
    name: "AdminAside",
    data() {
        return {
            userName: '',
            avatarUrl: ''
        }
    },
    created() {
        this.userName = localStorage.getItem('userName') || '管理员'
        this.loadAvatar()
    },
    methods: {
        loadAvatar() {
            const uid = Cookies.get('userId')
            if (uid) {
                this.avatarUrl = localStorage.getItem('user_avatar_' + uid) || ''
            }
        },
        logout() {
            this.$confirm('确定要退出登录吗？', '提示', { type: 'warning' }).then(() => {
                Cookies.remove('userId')
                Cookies.remove('classId')
                Cookies.remove('roleId')
                this.$router.push('/login')
                this.$message({ message: '退出成功', type: 'success' });
            }).catch(() => {})
        }
    }
}
</script>
<style scoped>

}

}
.avatar-img {

}
```

```vue
<template>
    <div>
        <el-button  @click="saveNewClass()" type="primary"> 新增班级</el-button>
        <el-dialog title="新增/编辑班级" :visible.sync="dialogFormVisible">
            <el-form :model="form">
                <el-form-item label="班级名称" :label-width="formLabelWidth">
                    <el-input v-model="form.className" autocomplete="off"></el-input>
                </el-form-item>
                <el-form-item label="班主任" :label-width="formLabelWidth">
                    <el-select v-model="form.userId" placeholder="请选择班主任">
                        <el-option v-for="c in form.allTeacher" :label="c.userName" :value="c.id" :key="c.id"></el-option>
                    </el-select>
                </el-form-item>
            </el-form>
            <div slot="footer" class="dialog-footer">
                <el-button @click="dialogFormVisible = false"> 取 消</el-button>
                <el-button type="primary" @click="submit(form)"> 确 定</el-button>
            </div>
        </el-dialog>
        <el-table
                :data="tableData"
                :default-sort="{prop: 'date', order: 'descending'}"
                style="width: 100%">
            <el-table-column
                    sortable
                    prop="createTime"
                    label="创建时间"
                    width="180">
            </el-table-column>
            <el-table-column
                    prop="userName"
                    label="班主任"
                    width="180">
            </el-table-column>
            <el-table-column
                    prop="className"
                    label="班级">
            </el-table-column>
            <el-table-column label="操作" width="260" fixed="right">
                <template slot-scope="scope">
                    <el-button
                            type="success"
                            @click="handleEdite(scope.$index, scope.row)"> 编辑
                    </el-button>
                    <el-button
                    type="danger"
                            @click="handleDelete(scope.$index, scope.row)"> 删除
                    </el-button>
                </template>
            </el-table-column>
        </el-table>
        <el-pagination
                @size-change="handleSizeChange"
                @current-change="handleCurrentChange"
                :current-page="page.page"
                :page-sizes="[10, 20, 30, 40]"
                :page-size="page.pageSize"
                layout="total, sizes, prev, pager, next, jumper"
                :total="tableData.length">
        </el-pagination>
    </div>
</template>
<script>
    import {listClass,delteClass,listTeacher,saveClass,updateClass} from '../../../api/admin/classmanagement.js'
    export default {
        name: "ClassManagement",
        data(){
            return{
                dialogFormVisible:false,
                form:{
                    className:'',
                    userId:0,
                    allTeacher:[],
                    id:'',
                },
                tableData:[],
                page: {
                    page: 1, 
                    pageSize: 10,    
                },
                param:{
                    id:'',
                },
                status:{
                    roleId:2
                },
                tag:'123',
            }
        },
        created() {
            this.listAllClass(this.page)
            this.listAllTeacher(this.status)
        },
        methods:{
            saveNewClass(){
                this.tag='new'
               console.log(this.tag)
                this.dialogFormVisible=true
            },
            handleEdite(index,row){
                this.dialogFormVisible=true
                this.form.className=row.className
                this.form.userId=row.userName
                this.form.id=row.id
            },
            submit(form){
                if(this.tag!='new'){
                    if(typeof this.form.userId =="string"){
                        this.form.userId= ''
                    }
                    console.log(this.tag,'pppp')
                    this.dialogFormVisible=false
                    updateClass(form).then(resp=>{
                        if(resp.data.code==200){
                            this.listAllClass(this.page)
                            this.$message({
                                message: '操作成功',
                                type: 'success'
                            });
                        }else {
                            this.$message.error('编辑失败');
                        }
                    })
                }else{
                    saveClass(form).then(resp=>{
                        this.dialogFormVisible=false
                        if(resp.data.code==200){
                            this.tag='123'
                            this.listAllClass(this.page)
                            this.$message({
                                message: '新增成功',
                                type: 'success'
                            });
                        }else {
                            this.$message.error('新增失败');
                        }
                    })
                }
            },
            listAllTeacher(status){
                listTeacher(status).then(resp=>{
                    this.form.allTeacher=resp.data.resultData
                })
            },
            handleDelete(index,row){
                this.param.id=row.id
                delteClass(this.param).then(resp=>{
                    if(resp.data.code==200){
                        this.$message({
                            message: '删除成功',
                            type: 'success'
                        });
                        this.listAllClass(this.page)
                    }else {
                        this.$message.error('删除失败');
                    }
                })
            },
            listAllClass(page){
                listClass(page).then(resp=>{
                    this.tableData=resp.data.resultData.data
                })
            },
            handleSizeChange(size) {
                this.page.pageSize = size;
                this.listAllClass(this.page)
                console.log(`每页 ${size} 条`);
            },
            handleCurrentChange(pageNum) {
                this.page.pageNum = pageNum;
                this.listAllClass(this.page)
                console.log(`当前页: ${val}`);
            },
        }
    }
</script>
```

```vue
<template>
    <div>
        <el-menu :default-active="1" mode="horizontal" style="line-height: 60px">
            <div class="cn">
                <div class="title">
                  <img src="@/assets/我的学习.png" alt="" style="width: 40px; height: 40px;position: relative;top: 5px;margin-left: 10px">
                  <div style="display: inline">
                    《智能终端应用开发》线上课程系统
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div class="blockl">
                    <el-submenu index="2">
                        <template slot="title">
                            <div class="demo-fit">
                                <div class="block">
                                    <i class="el-icon-user-solid"
                                        style="color: #8e99b0;margin-right: 25px;font-size: 32px;"></i>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </template>
                        <el-menu-item index="/checkhomework" @click="logout()">退出</el-menu-item>
                        <el-menu-item @click="change()"> 修改密码</el-menu-item>
                    </el-submenu>
                </div>
            </div>
        </el-menu>
        <div>
            <el-dialog title="修改密码" :visible.sync="dialogFormVisible" width="30%" :before-close="handleClose">
                <el-input placeholder="请输入原密码" v-model="changePassword.password" show-password></el-input>
                <el-input placeholder="请输入新密码" v-model="changePassword.newPassword" show-password></el-input>
                <el-input placeholder="请重新输入新密码" v-model="changePassword.conPassword" show-password></el-input>
                <span slot="footer" class="dialog-footer">
                    <el-button @click="dialogFormVisible = false"> 取 消</el-button>
                    <el-button type="primary" @click="submit(changePassword)"> 确 定</el-button>
                </span>
            </el-dialog>
        </div>
    </div>
</template>
<script>
import Cookies from "js-cookie";
import { password } from '../../../api/personal.js'
export default {
    name: "Header.vue",
    data() {
        return {
            changePassword: {
                password: '',
                conPassword: '',
                newPassword: '',
                id: ''
            },
            dialogFormVisible: false,
            info: {
                password: '',
                newPassword: '',
                id: ''
            },
            drawer: false
        }
    },
    created() {
        this.changePassword.id = Cookies.get("userId")
    },
    methods: {
        handleClose(done) {
            this.$confirm('确认关闭？')
                .then(() => {
                    done();
                })
                .catch(() => { });
        },
        change() {
            this.dialogFormVisible = true
        },
        submit(da) {
            if (this.changePassword.password.trim() == '') {
                this.$message({
                    message: '请输入原密码',
                    type: 'error'
                });
                return;
            }
            if (this.changePassword.newPassword.trim() == '') {
                this.$message({
                    message: '请输入新密码',
                    type: 'error'
                });
                return;
            }
            if (this.changePassword.conPassword != this.changePassword.newPassword) {
                this.$message({
                    message: '两次新密码不一致',
                    type: 'error'
                });
                return;
            }
            password(da).then(resp => {
                if (resp.data.code == 200) {
                    this.$message({
                        message: '密码修改成功 ',
                        type: 'success'
                    });
                    this.dialogFormVisible = false
                    this.studentquery(this.page)
                } else {
                    this.$message.error('原密码错误');
                }
            })
        },
        logout() {
            Cookies.remove('userId')
            Cookies.remove('classId')
            Cookies.remove('roleId')
            this.$router.push('/login')
            this.$message({
                message: '退出成功',
                type: 'success'
            });
        }
    }
}
</script>
<style scoped>
.block {
    height: 60px;
}
.blockl {
    position: absolute;
    right: 0px;
    line-height: 60px;
}
.ls {
    height: 100%;
}
.title {
    line-height: 100%;
    padding: 0 15px 15px 0;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #1a1a2e;
    position: absolute;
    font-size: 24px;
}
</style>
```

```vue
                pageSize: 10,

                id: ''
            }
        }

        handleCurrentChange(pageNum) {
```
