## frontend/src/views/studentweb/askandanswer/AskAndAnswer.vue

```vue
<template>
    <div class="ask-answer-page">
        <!-- ====== 顶部标题区 ====== -->
        <div class="hero-banner">
            <div class="hero-content">
                <div class="hero-icon-wrap">
                    <i class="el-icon-chat-dot-round"></i>
                </div>
                <div class="hero-text">
                    <h1 class="hero-title">问答社区</h1>
                    <p class="hero-subtitle">有问题尽管问，老师同学都在这里帮你</p>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <!-- ====== Tab 切换区 ====== -->
        <div class="tab-nav">
            <div class="tab-item" :class="{ active: activeTab === 'square' }" @click="activeTab = 'square'">
                <i class="el-icon-s-promotion"></i>
                <span>问答广场</span>
                <el-badge v-if="squareTotal > 0" :value="squareTotal" class="tab-badge" />
            </div>
            <div class="tab-item" :class="{ active: activeTab === 'ask' }" @click="activeTab = 'ask'">
                <i class="el-icon-edit-outline"></i>
                <span>我要提问</span>
            </div>
        </div>
        <!-- ====== 问答广场 ====== -->
        <div v-show="activeTab === 'square'" class="tab-content">
            <!-- 筛选 + 统计 -->
            <div class="square-toolbar">
                <div class="toolbar-left" style="display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;">
                    <el-select
                        v-model="squareFilterType"
                        placeholder="筛选类型"
                        size="small"
                        @change="onSquareFilter"
                    >
                        <el-option label="全部" value="all" />
                        <el-option label="通知公告" value="notice" />
                        <el-option label="问题" value="question" />
                    </el-select>
                    <el-select
                        v-model="squareFilterClassId"
                        placeholder="全部班级"
                        size="small"
                        clearable
                        @change="onSquareFilter"
                    >
                        <el-option
                            v-for="cls in enrolledClasses"
                            :key="cls.courseName + '-' + cls.classId"
                            :label="cls.courseName + ' - ' + cls.className"
                            :value="cls.classId"
                        />
                    </el-select>
                </div>
                <div class="toolbar-right">
                    <span class="square-count-text">共 <strong>{{ filteredSquareList.length }}</strong> 条</span>
                </div>
            </div>
            <!-- 空状态 -->
            <div v-if="filteredSquareList.length === 0" class="empty-state">
                <div class="empty-icon">
                    <i class="el-icon-chat-square"></i>
                </div>
                <p class="empty-title">暂无内容</p>
                <p class="empty-desc">切换筛选条件或去「我要提问」发布你的第一个问题吧</p>
                <el-button type="primary" size="small" @click="activeTab = 'ask'">去提问</el-button>
            </div>
            <!-- 混合卡片列表 -->
            <div v-else class="square-list">
                <!-- ====== 通知卡片 ====== -->
                <div v-for="item in filteredSquareList" :key="item._key">
                    <div
                        v-if="item._type === 'notice'"
                        class="notice-card"
                        :class="{ 'notice-pinned': item.isPinned == 1 }"
                    >
                        <div class="notice-card-left">
                            <div class="notice-dot" :class="item.isPinned == 1 ? 'dot-pinned' : 'dot-normal'"></div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="notice-card-body">
                            <div class="notice-card-head">
                                <span class="notice-card-title">
                                    <i v-if="item.isPinned == 1" class="el-icon-top" style="color:#F56C6C;margin-right:4px;"></i>
                                    {{ item.title }}
                                </span>
                                <el-tag size="mini" effect="plain" type="info">
                                    {{ item.courseName ? item.courseName + ' - ' : '' }}{{ item.className }}
                                </el-tag>
                            </div>
                            <p class="notice-card-content">{{ item.content }}</p>
                            <div class="notice-card-foot">
                                <span class="foot-sender">
                                    <el-avatar :size="20" style="vertical-align:middle;margin-right:4px;">{{ (item.senderName || '教')[0] }}</el-avatar>
                                    {{ item.senderName }}
                                </span>
                                <el-tag size="mini" type="warning" effect="plain">通知</el-tag>
                                <span class="foot-time">{{ item.createTime }}</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <!-- ====== 问题卡片 ====== -->
                    <div
                        v-else
                        class="qa-card"
                        :class="{ 'qa-answered': item.restore && item.restore !== 'undefined' }"
                    >
                        <div class="qa-card-head">
                            <div class="qa-head-left">
                                <span class="qa-topic-tag">
                                    <i class="el-icon-collection-tag"></i>
                                    {{ item.topic || '通用问题' }}
                                </span>
                                <span class="qa-sender-name">{{ item.senderName }}</span>
                            </div>
                            <div class="qa-head-right">
                                <el-tag v-if="item.restore && item.restore !== 'undefined'" type="success" size="small" effect="plain">已回复</el-tag>
                                <el-tag v-else type="warning" size="small" effect="plain">待回复</el-tag>
                                <el-tag size="mini" type="primary" effect="plain">问题</el-tag>
                                <span class="qa-time">{{ item.createTime }}</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="qa-card-question">
                            <div class="qa-label">📝 问题描述</div>
                            <div class="qa-text">
                                <p>{{ item.content }}</p>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="qa-card-reply">
                            <div class="qa-label">💬 老师回复</div>
                            <div v-if="item.restore && item.restore !== 'undefined'" class="qa-reply-body">
                                <el-avatar :size="28" style="margin-right:8px;">师</el-avatar>
                                <div class="qa-reply-box">
                                    <p class="qa-reply-text">{{ item.restore }}</p>
                                    <span class="qa-reply-teacher">— {{ item.recipientName || '老师' }}</span>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <p v-else class="qa-reply-waiting">
                                <i class="el-icon-time"></i> 老师正在赶来回复的路上...
                            </p>
                        </div>
                        <div v-if="item.className" class="qa-card-class">
                            <i class="el-icon-school"></i>
                            {{ item.courseName ? item.courseName + ' - ' : '' }}{{ item.className }}
                        </div>
                        <div class="qa-card-actions">
                            <el-button
                                v-if="canEditOrDelete(item)"
                                type="text"
                                size="small"
                                icon="el-icon-edit"
                                @click="startEdit(item)"
                            >修改</el-button>
                            <el-button
                                v-if="canEditOrDelete(item)"
                                type="text"
                                size="small"
                                icon="el-icon-delete"
                                style="color:#F56C6C;"
                                @click="confirmDelete(item.id)"
                            >删除</el-button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <!-- 修改对话框 -->
            <div v-if="editingId" class="qa-edit-inline" style="margin-top:12px;">
                <el-card shadow="never">
                    <el-input type="textarea" v-model="editContent" :rows="3" placeholder="修改你的问题..." />
                    <div style="margin-top:8px;display:flex;gap:8px;">
                        <el-button type="primary" size="small" @click="confirmEdit(editingId)">保存</el-button>
                        <el-button size="small" @click="cancelEdit">取消</el-button>
                    </div>
                </el-card>
            </div>
        </div>
        <!-- ====== 我要提问 ====== -->
        <div v-show="activeTab === 'ask'" class="tab-content">
            <el-card shadow="never" class="ask-card">
                <div slot="header" class="ask-card-header">
                    <i class="el-icon-edit-outline"></i>
                    <span>写下你的问题</span>
                </div>
                <el-form :model="askForm" label-position="top">
                    <el-form-item label="问题描述">
                        <el-input
                            type="textarea"
                            v-model="askForm.content"
                            placeholder="请详细描述你遇到的问题，描述越清楚，收到的回答越准确..."
                            :rows="5"
                            maxlength="500"
                            show-word-limit
                        />
                    </el-form-item>
                    <el-form-item label="选择班级（可选）">
                        <el-select
                            v-model="askForm.classId"
                            placeholder="不选择则全员可见"
                            size="small"
                            clearable
                            style="width:100%;"
                        >
                            <el-option
                                v-for="cls in enrolledClasses"
                                :key="'ask-' + cls.classId"
                                :label="cls.courseName + ' - ' + cls.className"
                                :value="cls.classId"
                            />
                        </el-select>
                        <span style="font-size:12px;color:#909399;margin-top:4px;display:block;">
                            <i class="el-icon-info"></i> 选择班级后仅该班学生可见，不选择则所有人可见
                        </span>
                    </el-form-item>
                    <el-form-item>
                        <el-button
                            type="primary"
                            size="medium"
                            icon="el-icon-send"
                            :loading="submitting"
                            @click="submitQuestion"
                        >
                            发布问题
                        </el-button>
                        <span class="ask-hint">发布后老师会收到通知并及时回复</span>
                    </el-form-item>
                </el-form>
            </el-card>
        </div>
    </div>
</template>
<script>
import { askandanswer, deleteQuestion, updateQuestion, saveQuestion, getStudentNotices, getEnrolledClasses } from '../../../api/studentweb/askandanswer.js'
import Cookies from 'js-cookie'
export default {
    name: 'AskAndAnswer',
    data() {
        return {
            userId: null,
            activeTab: 'square',
            submitting: false,
            enrolledClasses: [],
            noticeList: [],
            NotHomeWork: [],
            questionTotal: 0,
            squareFilterType: 'all',
            squareFilterClassId: null,
            askForm: { content: '', sender: null, recipient: 2, videoId: 1, status: 2, classId: null },
            editingId: null,
            editContent: ''
        }
    },
    computed: {
        squareList() {
            const notices = this.noticeList.map(n => ({
                ...n,
                _type: 'notice',
                _key: 'notice-' + n.id
            }))
            const questions = this.NotHomeWork.map(q => ({
                ...q,
                _type: 'question',
                _key: 'qa-' + q.id
            }))
            const merged = [...notices, ...questions]
            merged.sort((a, b) => {
                const ta = a.createTime || ''
                const tb = b.createTime || ''
                return tb.localeCompare(ta)
            })
            return merged
        },
        filteredSquareList() {
            return this.squareList.filter(item => {
                if (this.squareFilterType && this.squareFilterType !== 'all') {
                    if (item._type !== this.squareFilterType) return false
                }
                if (this.squareFilterClassId) {
                    const cid = item._type === 'notice'
                        ? item.classId
                        : (item.classId || null)
                    if (cid != this.squareFilterClassId) return false
                }
                return true
            })
        },
        squareTotal() {
            return this.noticeList.length + this.NotHomeWork.length
        }
    },
    created() {
        this.userId = Number(Cookies.get('userId'))
        this.askForm.sender = this.userId
        this.initData()
    },
    methods: {
        initData() {
            this.loadEnrolledClasses()
            this.loadNotices()
            this.loadQuestions()
        },
        async loadEnrolledClasses() {
            try {
                const res = await getEnrolledClasses(this.userId)
                if (res.data.code === 200) {
                    const raw = res.data.resultData || []
                    const seen = {}
                    this.enrolledClasses = raw.filter(item => {
                        const key = item.className + '-' + item.classId
                        if (seen[key]) return false
                        seen[key] = true
                        return true
                    })
                }
            } catch (e) { this.enrolledClasses = [] }
        },
        onSquareFilter() {},
        async loadNotices() {
            try {
                const params = { userId: this.userId, page: 1, pageSize: 100 }
                if (this.squareFilterClassId) {
                    params.classId = this.squareFilterClassId
                }
                const res = await getStudentNotices(params)
                if (res.data.code === 200) {
                    this.noticeList = (res.data.resultData && res.data.resultData.data) || []
                }
            } catch (e) { this.noticeList = [] }
        },
        async loadQuestions() {
            try {
                const params = { page: 1, pageSize: 100, userId: this.userId, roleId: 3 }
                const res = await askandanswer(params)
                if (res.data.code === 200) {
                    const data = res.data.resultData
                    this.NotHomeWork = (data && (data.data || data.records)) || []
                    this.questionTotal = (data && data.total) || 0
                }
            } catch (e) { this.NotHomeWork = [] }
        },
        submitQuestion() {
            if (!this.askForm.content.trim()) { this.$message.error('问题内容不能为空'); return }
            this.askForm.sender = this.userId
            this.askForm.classId = this.askForm.classId || null
            this.submitting = true
            saveQuestion(this.askForm).then(res => {
                if (res.data.code === 200) {
                    this.$message.success('提问成功！老师会尽快回复你')
                    this.askForm.content = ''
                    this.askForm.classId = null
                    this.loadQuestions()
                    this.activeTab = 'square'
                } else {
                    this.$message.error('提问失败')
                }
            }).catch(() => this.$message.error('网络错误')).finally(() => { this.submitting = false })
        },
        canEditOrDelete(q) {
            const s = q.status
            return s === '未回复' || s === '2' || !s || q.restore === undefined || q.restore === null || q.restore === 'undefined'
        },
        startEdit(q) { this.editingId = q.id; this.editContent = q.content },
        confirmEdit(id) {
            if (!this.editContent.trim()) { this.$message.error('问题内容不能为空'); return }
            updateQuestion({ id, content: this.editContent }).then(res => {
                if (res.data.code === 200) {
                    this.$message.success('修改成功')
                    this.editingId = null; this.editContent = ''
                    this.loadQuestions()
                } else { this.$message.error('修改失败') }
            }).catch(() => this.$message.error('网络错误'))
        },
        cancelEdit() { this.editingId = null; this.editContent = '' },
        confirmDelete(id) {
            this.$confirm('确定要删除这个问题吗？', '提示', { type: 'warning' }).then(() => {
                deleteQuestion({ id }).then(res => {
                    if (res.data.code === 200) { this.$message.success('已删除'); this.loadQuestions() }
                    else { this.$message.error('删除失败') }
                })
            }).catch(() => {})
        }
    }
}
</script>

## frontend/src/views/studentweb/contain/home.vue

```vue
<template>
    <div class="home-container">
        <el-carousel :interval="4000" type="card" height="400px">
            <el-carousel-item>
                <img src="@/assets/11.png" alt="banner1" style="height: 100%">
            </el-carousel-item>
            <el-carousel-item>
                <img src="@/assets/22.jpg" alt="banner2" style="height: 100%">
            </el-carousel-item>
            <el-carousel-item>
                <img src="@/assets/33.png" alt="banner3" style="height: 100%">
            </el-carousel-item>
            <el-carousel-item>
                <img src="@/assets/44.png" alt="banner4" style="height: 100%">
            </el-carousel-item>
            <el-carousel-item>
                <img src="@/assets/44.jpg" alt="banner5" style="height: 100%">
            </el-carousel-item>
            <el-carousel-item>
                <img src="@/assets/66.jpg" alt="banner6" style="height: 100%">
            </el-carousel-item>
        </el-carousel>
        <!-- 课程广场：展示所有课程卡片 -->
        <div class="course-plaza">
            <h2 class="section-title">📚 课程广场</h2>
            <div v-if="courses.length === 0" class="empty-tip">
                暂无课程数据
            </div>
            <el-row :gutter="20">
                <el-col :span="6" v-for="course in courses" :key="course.id" class="course-card-col">
                    <el-card shadow="hover" class="course-card" @click.native="goToCourse(course)">
                        <div class="card-cover">
                            <img
                                v-if="resolveCoverUrl(course) && !failedCoverMap[course.id]"
                                :src="String(resolveCoverUrl(course))"
                                :alt="course.courseName || course.course_name"
                                @error="onCoverError(course)"
                            />
                            <div v-else class="cover-fallback" :style="{ background: getCoverColor(course.id) }">
                                <span class="cover-letter">{{ (course.courseName || course.course_name || '课').charAt(0).toUpperCase() }}</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="card-body">
                            <h3 class="card-title">{{ course.courseName || course.course_name }}</h3>
                            <p class="card-desc">{{ course.description || course.courseDescription || course.course_description || '暂无描述' }}</p>
                        </div>
                    </el-card>
                </el-col>
            </el-row>
        </div>
    </div>
</template>
<script>
import { getAllCourses } from "@/api/studentweb/courses";
export default {
    name: "home",
    data() {
        return {
            courses: [],
            failedCoverMap: {}
        }
    },
    created() {
        this.fetchCourses();
    },
    methods: {
        fetchCourses() {
            getAllCourses().then(res => {
                if (res && res.data && res.data.code === 200 && Array.isArray(res.data.resultData)) {
                    this.courses = res.data.resultData;
                } else if (res && res.data && res.data.code === 200 && Array.isArray(res.data.data)) {
                    this.courses = res.data.data;
                } else if (res && Array.isArray(res)) {
                    this.courses = res;
                } else if (res && res.data && Array.isArray(res.data)) {
                    this.courses = res.data;
                } else {
                    console.warn('课程数据格式异常:', res);
                    this.courses = [];
                }
                this.failedCoverMap = {};
            }).catch(() => {
                this.courses = [];
                this.failedCoverMap = {};
            });
        },
        resolveCoverUrl(course) {
            if (!course) return '';
            const raw = course.coverUrl || course.cover_url;
            if (raw == null) return '';
            const url = String(raw).trim();
            if (!url) return '';
            if (url.startsWith('http:
                return url;
            }
            const base = (this.$store && this.$store.state && this.$store.state.baseApi) || '';
            if (url.startsWith('./')) {
                return base + '/resource/' + url.substring(2);
            }
            if (url.startsWith('/')) {
                return base + url;
            }
            return base + '/resource/' + url;
        },
        onCoverError(course) {
            if (course && course.id != null) {
                this.$set(this.failedCoverMap, course.id, true);
            }
        },
        getCoverColor(id) {
            const colors = [
                'linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%)',
                'linear-gradient(135deg, #f093fb 0%, #f5576c 100%)',
                'linear-gradient(135deg, #4facfe 0%, #00f2fe 100%)',
                'linear-gradient(135deg, #43e97b 0%, #38f9d7 100%)',
                'linear-gradient(135deg, #fa709a 0%, #fee140 100%)',
                'linear-gradient(135deg, #a18cd1 0%, #fbc2eb 100%)',
                'linear-gradient(135deg, #fccb90 0%, #d57eeb 100%)',
                'linear-gradient(135deg, #e0c3fc 0%, #8ec5fc 100%)'
            ];
            const key = String(id == null ? '' : id);
            let hash = 0;
            for (let i = 0; i < key.length; i++) {
                hash = ((hash << 5) - hash) + key.charCodeAt(i);
            }
            return colors[Math.abs(hash) % colors.length];
        },
        goToCourse(course) {
            this.$router.push({
                name: 'CourseDetail',
                query: { courseId: course.id, courseName: course.courseName || course.course_name }
            });
        }
    }
}
</script>
<style scoped>
.home-container {
    padding: 0 20px;
}
.section-title {
    font-size: 24px;
    color: #303133;
    margin: 30px 0 20px;
    padding-bottom: 10px;
    border-bottom: 2px solid #4e6ef2;
}
.empty-tip {
    text-align: center;
    color: #909399;
    padding: 40px 0;
    font-size: 16px;
}
.course-card-col {
    margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.course-card {
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s;
    border-radius: 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
}
.course-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-4px);
    box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(78, 110, 242, 0.15);
}
.card-cover {
    width: 100%;
    height: 140px;
    overflow: hidden;
}
.card-cover img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;

```vue
<template>
    <div class="course-learning-container">
        <!-- 顶部导航 -->
        <div class="learning-header">
            <el-button type="text" @click="goBack" class="back-btn">
                <i class="el-icon-arrow-left"></i> 返回
            </el-button>
            <h1 class="course-title">{{ courseName }} - 学习</h1>
            <div class="header-info">
                <el-tag v-if="teacherName" type="success" size="small">
                    <i class="el-icon-user-solid"></i> {{ teacherName }}
                </el-tag>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="learning-body">
            <!-- 左侧章节导航 -->
            <div class="chapter-sidebar" v-loading="loadingChapters">
                <div class="sidebar-title">
                    <i class="el-icon-s-order"></i> 课程章节
                </div>
                <el-tree
                    ref="chapterTree"
                    :data="chapterTree"
                    :props="treeProps"
                    node-key="id"
                    :highlight-current="true"
                    :expand-on-click-node="false"
                    @node-click="onChapterClick"
                    default-expand-all
                >
                    <span class="custom-tree-node" slot-scope="{ node, data }">
                        <span class="tree-node-icon">
                            <i v-if="data.chapterType === 1" class="el-icon-folder"></i>
                            <i v-else class="el-icon-document"></i>
                        </span>
                        <span class="tree-node-label">{{ data.chapterName }}</span>
                        <el-tag v-if="data.resourceCount" size="mini" type="info">
                            {{ data.resourceCount }}
                        </el-tag>
                    </span>
                </el-tree>
            </div>
            <!-- 右侧内容区 -->
            <div class="content-area">
                <!-- 未选择章节提示 -->
                <div v-if="!selectedChapter" class="content-placeholder">
                    <i class="el-icon-notebook-1"></i>
                    <p>请从左侧章节列表选择一个章节开始学习</p>
                </div>
                <!-- 章节内容列表 -->
                <template v-else>
                    <div class="chapter-info">
                        <h2 class="chapter-title">
                            <i v-if="selectedChapter.chapterType === 1" class="el-icon-folder-opened"></i>
                            <i v-else class="el-icon-document-copy"></i>
                            {{ selectedChapter.chapterName }}
                        </h2>
                        <p v-if="selectedChapter.description" class="chapter-desc">
                            {{ selectedChapter.description }}
                        </p>
                    </div>
                    <div v-loading="loadingContents" class="contents-list">
                        <!-- 空内容 -->
                        <div v-if="contents.length === 0" class="empty-contents">
                            <i class="el-icon-document-empty"></i>
                            <p>该章节暂无学习内容</p>
                        </div>
                        <!-- 内容卡片列表 -->
                        <div
                            v-for="(content, index) in contents"
                            :key="content.id || index"
                            class="content-card"
                            @click="openContent(content)"
                        >
                            <div class="content-icon-wrapper" :class="getContentIconClass(content.contentType)">
                                <i :class="getContentIcon(content.contentType)"></i>
                            </div>
                            <div class="content-info">
                                <h4 class="content-title">{{ content.title || content.contentTitle || '未命名内容' }}</h4>
                                <p class="content-desc">
                                    {{ content.description || getContentTypeLabel(content.contentType) }}
                                </p>
                                <span class="content-meta">
                                    <i class="el-icon-time"></i>
                                    {{ content.duration || content.videoDuration || '--' }}
                                </span>
                            </div>
                            <div class="content-action">
                                <el-button type="primary" size="mini" round>开始学习</el-button>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </template>
            </div>
        </div>
        <!-- 内容查看弹窗 -->
        <el-dialog
            :title="currentContentTitle"
            :visible.sync="contentDialogVisible"
            :width="dialogWidth"
            :fullscreen="isFullscreen"
            top="20px"
            class="content-dialog"
            @close="onDialogClose"
        >
            <!-- 视频播放 -->
            <div v-if="currentContentType === 1" class="video-player-wrapper">
                <video
                    v-if="currentVideoUrl"
                    :src="currentVideoUrl"
                    controls
                    autoplay
                    class="video-player"
                    style="width: 100%; max-height: 70vh;"
                ></video>
                <div v-else class="no-video-tip">
                    <i class="el-icon-video-play"></i>
                    <p>视频资源加载中...</p>
                </div>
            </div>
            <!-- 阅读/知识点内容 -->
            <div v-else-if="currentContentType === 2" class="reading-content" v-html="currentHtmlContent">
            </div>
            <!-- 资源文件 -->
            <div v-else-if="currentContentType === 3" class="resource-content">
                <el-alert title="此内容为文件资源" type="info" :closable="false" show-icon>
                </el-alert>
                <div class="resource-download">
                    <a :href="currentFileUrl" target="_blank" class="resource-link" v-if="currentFileUrl">
                        <el-button type="primary" icon="el-icon-download">下载查看文件</el-button>
                    </a>
                    <p v-else class="no-resource-tip">暂无文件资源</p>
                </div>
            </div>
            <!-- 兜底：未识别的内容类型，显示原始信息 -->
            <div v-else class="resource-content">
                <el-alert
                    :title="'未识别的内容类型 (contentType=' + currentContentType + ')'"
                    type="warning"
                    :closable="false"
                    show-icon
                ></el-alert>
                <div class="resource-download" v-if="currentFileUrl">
                    <a :href="currentFileUrl" target="_blank" class="resource-link">
                        <el-button type="primary" icon="el-icon-link">打开资源</el-button>
                    </a>
                </div>
            </div>
        </el-dialog>
    </div>
</template>
<script>
import {
    getLearningChapters,
    getChapterContents
} from "@/api/studentweb/courses";
export default {
    name: "CourseLearning",
    data() {
        return {
            courseId: null,
            courseName: '',
            teacherName: '',
            classId: null,
            chapterTree: [],
            treeProps: {
                children: 'children',
                label: 'chapterName'
            },
            loadingChapters: false,
            selectedChapter: null,
            contents: [],
            loadingContents: false,
            contentDialogVisible: false,
            currentContentTitle: '',
            currentContentType: null,
            currentVideoUrl: '',
            currentHtmlContent: '',
            currentFileUrl: '',
            isFullscreen: false,
            dialogWidth: '80%'
        }
    },
    created() {
        this.courseId = this.$route.query.courseId || this.$route.params.courseId;
        this.courseName = this.$route.query.courseName || this.$route.params.courseName || '';
        this.teacherName = this.$route.query.teacherName || '';
        this.classId = this.$route.query.classId || this.$route.params.classId;
        if (this.classId) {
            this.loadChapters();
        }
    },
    methods: {
        goBack() {
            this.$router.push({ name: 'Courses' });
        },
        async loadChapters() {
            if (!this.classId) return;
            this.loadingChapters = true;
            try {
                const res = await getLearningChapters({ classId: this.classId, courseId: this.courseId });
                const list = this.parseResponseData(res);
                this.chapterTree = this.buildChapterTree(list || []);
            } catch (err) {
                console.error('获取章节失败:', err);
                this.$message.error('获取课程章节失败');
                this.chapterTree = [];
            } finally {
                this.loadingChapters = false;
            }
        },
        buildChapterTree(flatList) {
            const nodeMap = new Map();
            const roots = [];
            flatList.forEach(item => {
                const node = {
                    ...item,
                    children: [],
                    resourceCount: item.resourceCount || 0
                };
                nodeMap.set(item.id, node);
            });
            flatList.forEach(item => {
                const node = nodeMap.get(item.id);
                if (item.parentId && nodeMap.has(item.parentId)) {
                    const parent = nodeMap.get(item.parentId);
                    parent.children.push(node);
                    parent.resourceCount = (parent.resourceCount || 0) + (node.resourceCount || 0);
                } else {
                    roots.push(node);
                }
            });
            return roots;
        },
        async onChapterClick(nodeData) {
            this.selectedChapter = nodeData;
            this.loadContents(nodeData.id);
        },
    async loadContents(chapterId) {
        if (!chapterId) return;
        this.loadingContents = true;
        this.contents = [];
        try {
            const res = await getChapterContents({ chapterId });
            let list = this.parseResponseData(res) || [];
            const videoExtensions = ['.webm', '.mp4', '.mkv', '.avi', '.mov'];
            list = list.map(item => {
                const url = item.videoUrl || item.fileUrl || '';
                if (item.contentType !== 1 && url) {
                    const isVideo = videoExtensions.some(ext => url.toLowerCase().endsWith(ext));
                    if (isVideo) {
                        item.contentType = 1;
                        item.videoUrl = url;
                    }
                }
                return item;
            });
            this.contents = list;
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('获取章节内容失败:', err);
            this.$message.error('获取学习内容失败');
            this.contents = [];
        } finally {
            this.loadingContents = false;
        }
    },
    openContent(content) {
        this.currentContentTitle = content.title || content.contentTitle || '学习内容';
        let actualContentType = content.contentType;
        const videoExtensions = ['.webm', '.mp4', '.mkv', '.avi', '.mov'];
        const readingExtensions = ['.md', '.markdown', '.txt', '.html', '.htm'];
        const url = content.videoUrl || content.fileUrl || '';
        const lowerUrl = url.toLowerCase();
        if (videoExtensions.some(ext => lowerUrl.endsWith(ext))) {
            actualContentType = 1;
        } else if (readingExtensions.some(ext => lowerUrl.endsWith(ext))) {
            actualContentType = 2;
        } else if (actualContentType !== 1 && actualContentType !== 2 && actualContentType !== 3) {
            actualContentType = 3;
        }
        this.currentContentType = actualContentType;
        if (actualContentType === 1) {
            const rawUrl = content.videoUrl || content.fileUrl || '';
            this.currentVideoUrl = rawUrl || '';
            this.isFullscreen = false;
            this.dialogWidth = '80%';
        } else if (actualContentType === 2) {
            const inline = content.htmlContent || content.content;
            if (inline && !inline.startsWith('/') && !inline.startsWith('http')) {
                this.currentHtmlContent = inline;
            } else {
                this.currentHtmlContent = '<p style="color:#909399;text-align:center;padding:40px;">正在加载...</p>';
                this.fetchReadingContent(url);
            }
            this.isFullscreen = true;
            this.dialogWidth = '90%';
        } else if (actualContentType === 3) {
            this.currentFileUrl = url;
            this.isFullscreen = false;
            this.dialogWidth = '60%';
        }
        this.contentDialogVisible = true;
    },
    fetchReadingContent(url) {
        const baseApi = (this.$store && this.$store.state && this.$store.state.baseApi) || '';
        const fullUrl = url.startsWith('http') ? url : baseApi + url;
        fetch(fullUrl)
            .then(res => res.ok ? res.text() : Promise.reject('HTTP ' + res.status))
            .then(text => {
                this.currentHtmlContent = this.renderMarkdown(text);
            })
            .catch(err => {
                this.currentHtmlContent = '<p style="color:#F56C6C;text-align:center;padding:40px;">加载失败：' + err + '</p>';
            });
    },
    renderMarkdown(md) {
        if (!md) return '';
        const escapeHtml = s => s.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
        const lines = md.split('\n');
        let html = '';
        let inCode = false;
        let inList = false;
        for (let raw of lines) {
            if (raw.startsWith('```')) {
                if (!inCode) { html += '<pre style="background:#f5f7fa;padding:12px;border-radius:6px;overflow:auto;"><code>'; inCode = true; }
                else { html += '</code></pre>'; inCode = false; }
                continue;
            }
            if (inCode) { html += escapeHtml(raw) + '\n'; continue; }
            if (/^#\s+/.test(raw))      { if (inList) { html += '</ul>'; inList = false; } html += '<h1 style="margin:18px 0 12px;">' + escapeHtml(raw.replace(/^#\s+/, '')) + '</h1>'; continue; }
            if (/^##\s+/.test(raw))     { if (inList) { html += '</ul>'; inList = false; } html += '<h2 style="margin:16px 0 10px;">' + escapeHtml(raw.replace(/^##\s+/, '')) + '</h2>'; continue; }
            if (/^###\s+/.test(raw))    { if (inList) { html += '</ul>'; inList = false; } html += '<h3 style="margin:14px 0 8px;">' + escapeHtml(raw.replace(/^###\s+/, '')) + '</h3>'; continue; }
            if (/^[-*]\s+/.test(raw))   { if (!inList) { html += '<ul style="padding-left:24px;">'; inList = true; } html += '<li>' + escapeHtml(raw.replace(/^[-*]\s+/, '')) + '</li>'; continue; }
            if (/^\d+\.\s+/.test(raw))  { if (!inList) { html += '<ol style="padding-left:24px;">'; inList = true; } html += '<li>' + escapeHtml(raw.replace(/^\d+\.\s+/, '')) + '</li>'; continue; }
            if (inList) { html += '</ul>'; inList = false; }
            const trimmed = raw.trim();
            if (trimmed) html += '<p style="margin:8px 0;line-height:1.7;">' + escapeHtml(trimmed) + '</p>';
        }
        if (inList) html += '</ul>';
        if (inCode) html += '</code></pre>';
        return html;
    },
        onDialogClose() {
            this.currentVideoUrl = '';
            this.currentHtmlContent = '';
            this.currentFileUrl = '';
        },
        getContentIcon(type) {
            const icons = {
                1: 'el-icon-video-play',
                2: 'el-icon-reading',
                3: 'el-icon-files'
            };
            return icons[type] || 'el-icon-document';
        },
        getContentIconClass(type) {
            const classes = {
                1: 'video-icon',
                2: 'reading-icon',
                3: 'resource-icon'
            };
            return classes[type] || '';
        },
        getContentTypeLabel(type) {
            const labels = {
                1: '视频学习',
                2: '阅读材料',
                3: '文件资源'
            };
            return labels[type] || '学习内容';
        },
        parseResponseData(res) {
            if (res && res.code === 200 && Array.isArray(res.resultData)) {
                return res.resultData;
            }
            if (res && res.data && res.data.code === 200 && Array.isArray(res.data.resultData)) {
                return res.data.resultData;
            }
            if (res && Array.isArray(res)) {
                return res;
            }
            return [];
        }
    }
}
</script>

## frontend/src/views/studentweb/courses/Courses.vue

```vue
<template>
    <div class="courses-container">
        <!-- ========== 单个课程详情模式 ========== -->
        <div v-if="mode === 'detail'" class="course-detail">
            <div class="detail-header">
                <el-button
                    type="text"
                    icon="el-icon-arrow-left"
                    class="back-btn"
                    @click="goBack"
                >返回</el-button>
                <el-breadcrumb separator="/" class="detail-breadcrumb">
                    <el-breadcrumb-item :to="{ path: '/home' }">课程广场</el-breadcrumb-item>
                    <el-breadcrumb-item>{{ currentCourseName }}</el-breadcrumb-item>
                </el-breadcrumb>
            </div>
            <div v-if="loading" class="loading-state">
                <i class="el-icon-loading"></i>
                <span>加载中...</span>
            </div>
            <div v-else-if="courseDetail" class="detail-content">
                <!-- 顶部封面 + 概要信息 -->
                <el-card class="detail-hero-card" shadow="hover">
                    <div class="hero-wrap">
                        <div class="hero-cover">
                            <img
                                v-if="resolvedCoverUrl && !coverFailed"
                                :src="resolvedCoverUrl"
                                class="hero-cover-img"
                                alt="封面"
                                @error="coverFailed = true"
                            />
                            <div v-else class="hero-cover-fallback">
                                <i class="el-icon-notebook-2"></i>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="hero-info">
                            <h1 class="hero-title">{{ courseDetail.courseName }}</h1>
                            <div class="hero-tags">
                                <el-tag
                                    :type="courseDetail.status === 1 ? 'success' : (courseDetail.status === 2 ? 'info' : 'warning')"
                                    size="small"
                                    effect="dark"
                                >
                                    <i class="el-icon-s-flag"></i>
                                    {{ courseDetail.status === 1 ? '启用' : courseDetail.status === 2 ? '停用' : '草稿' }}
                                </el-tag>
                                <el-tag v-if="courseDetail.chapters" size="small" type="primary">
                                    <i class="el-icon-document"></i>
                                    {{ courseDetail.chapters.length }} 个章节
                                </el-tag>
                                <el-tag size="small">
                                    <i class="el-icon-s-home"></i>
                                    {{ classList.length }} 个班级
                                </el-tag>
                            </div>
                            <p class="hero-desc">
                                {{ courseDetail.description || '暂无课程描述' }}
                            </p>
                            <div class="hero-meta">
                                <span class="hero-meta-item">
                                    <i class="el-icon-time"></i>
                                    创建时间：{{ courseDetail.createTime || '-' }}
                                </span>
                                <span v-if="enrolledClasses.size > 0" class="hero-meta-item enrolled">
                                    <i class="el-icon-success"></i>
                                    已选 {{ enrolledClasses.size }} 个班级
                                </span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </el-card>
                <!-- 课程简介（详细介绍） -->
                <el-card class="detail-intro-card" shadow="hover">
                    <div slot="header" class="section-header">
                        <span class="section-title">
                            <i class="el-icon-reading"></i>
                            课程简介
                        </span>
                        <el-button
                            type="text"
                            size="mini"
                            @click="introExpanded = !introExpanded"
                        >
                            {{ introExpanded ? '收起' : '展开全部' }}
                            <i :class="introExpanded ? 'el-icon-arrow-up' : 'el-icon-arrow-down'"></i>
                        </el-button>
                    </div>
                    <pre class="intro-text" :class="{ collapsed: !introExpanded }">{{ courseIntroText }}</pre>
                </el-card>
                <!-- 章节列表 -->
                <el-card class="detail-chapters-card" shadow="hover" v-if="courseDetail.chapters">
                    <div slot="header" class="section-header">
                        <span class="section-title">
                            <i class="el-icon-files"></i>
                            课程章节
                        </span>
                        <el-tag size="mini" type="info">共 {{ courseDetail.chapters.length }} 章</el-tag>
                    </div>
                    <div v-if="courseDetail.chapters.length > 0" class="chapters-list">
                        <div
                            v-for="(chapter, idx) in courseDetail.chapters"
                            :key="idx"
                            class="chapter-item"
                        >
                            <div class="chapter-index-badge">{{ idx + 1 }}</div>
                            <div class="chapter-content">
                                <div class="chapter-name">{{ chapter.chapterName || chapter.name }}</div>
                                <div class="chapter-sub" v-if="chapter.description || chapter.chapterDescription">
                                    {{ chapter.description || chapter.chapterDescription }}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <i class="el-icon-arrow-right chapter-arrow"></i>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div v-else class="empty-chapter">
                        <i class="el-icon-folder-opened"></i>
                        <span>暂无章节</span>
                    </div>
                </el-card>
                <!-- 关联班级 -->
                <el-card class="detail-classes-card" shadow="hover">
                    <div slot="header" class="section-header">
                        <span class="section-title">
                            <i class="el-icon-s-home"></i>
                            关联班级
                        </span>
                        <el-tag size="mini" type="success" v-if="enrolledClasses.size > 0">
                            已选 {{ enrolledClasses.size }} / {{ classList.length }}
                        </el-tag>
                        <el-tag size="mini" type="info" v-else>共 {{ classList.length }} 个</el-tag>
                    </div>
                    <div v-if="classList.length > 0" class="classes-list">
                        <div v-for="(cls, idx) in classList" :key="idx" class="class-item">
                            <div class="class-info">
                                <i class="el-icon-s-home class-icon"></i>
                                <span class="class-name">{{ cls.className }}</span>
                                <el-tag v-if="cls.semester === 1" size="mini" type="success">春季</el-tag>
                                <el-tag v-else-if="cls.semester === 2" size="mini" type="warning">秋季</el-tag>
                            </div>
                            <div class="class-actions">
                                <!-- 已选课：显示已选标签 + 退选按钮 -->
                                <template v-if="enrolledClasses.has(cls.id || cls.classId)">
                                    <el-tag size="mini" type="success" class="enrolled-badge">已选</el-tag>
                                    <el-button
                                        size="mini"
                                        type="danger"
                                        plain
                                        @click.stop="handleUnenroll(cls)"
                                        :loading="enrollingClassId === (cls.id || cls.classId)"
                                    >
                                        退选
                                    </el-button>
                                </template>
                                <!-- 未选课：显示选课按钮 -->
                                <template v-else>
                                    <el-button
                                        size="mini"
                                        type="primary"
                                        @click.stop="handleEnroll(cls)"
                                        :loading="enrollingClassId === (cls.id || cls.classId)"
                                    >
                                        选课
                                    </el-button>
                                </template>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div v-else class="empty-classes">
                        <i class="el-icon-warning-outline"></i>
                        <span>暂无关联班级</span>
                    </div>
                </el-card>
            </div>
            <div v-else class="empty-state">
                <i class="el-icon-document-deleted empty-icon"></i>
                <p class="empty-text">课程不存在或已被删除</p>
            </div>
        </div>
        <!-- ========== 课程列表模式 ========== -->
        <div v-else>
            <div class="page-header">
                <h1 class="page-title">课程列表</h1>
                <span class="course-count">共 {{ courseList.length }} 门课程</span>
            </div>
            <!-- 加载状态 -->
            <div v-if="loading" class="loading-state">
                <i class="el-icon-loading"></i>
                <span>加载中...</span>
            </div>
            <!-- 课程列表 -->
            <div v-else-if="courseList.length > 0" class="course-grid">
                <div
                    v-for="(course, index) in courseList"
                    :key="index"
                    class="course-card"
                    @click="openCourseDetail(course)"
                >
                    <div class="card-header">
                        <div class="course-name">{{ course.courseName || course.name || '未命名课程' }}</div>
                        <el-tag size="mini" type="success" v-if="course.semester === 1">春季</el-tag>
                        <el-tag size="mini" type="warning" v-else-if="course.semester === 2">秋季</el-tag>
                    </div>
                    <div class="card-body">
                        <p class="course-desc" v-if="course.description || course.courseDescription">
                            {{ course.description || course.courseDescription }}
                        </p>
                        <p class="course-desc empty-desc" v-else>暂无课程描述</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="card-teacher">
                        <i class="el-icon-user-solid"></i>
                        <span>{{ course.userName || course.teacherName || '未指定教师' }}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="card-arrow">
                        <i class="el-icon-arrow-right"></i>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <!-- 空状态 -->
            <div v-else class="empty-state">
                <i class="el-icon-notebook-1 empty-icon"></i>
                <p class="empty-text">暂无课程数据</p>
                <p class="empty-hint">请联系教师加入班级</p>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</template>
<script>
import { getAllCourses, getCourseById, getClassesByCourseId, getUserClassList, enrollClass, unenrollClass } from "@/api/studentweb/courses";
import Cookies from 'js-cookie';
export default {
    name: "Courses",
    data() {
        return {
            mode: 'list',       
            courseList: [],
            courseDetail: null,
            classList: [],
            loading: false,
            userId: null,
            enrolledClasses: new Set(),   
            enrollingClassId: null,        
            coverFailed: false,
            introExpanded: false,
            defaultIntroText: `课程目标
掌握 Kotlin 与 Jetpack Compose 的基础知识
构建基础的 Android 应用程序
使用 Jetpack 库以及现代 Android 开发实践
为不同屏幕尺寸创建自适应布局
学习前提
具备基础的计算机操作能力
具备基础的数学知识
一台能够运行 Android Studio 的电脑（详见系统要求）
（可选）一台 Android 设备
单元 1：你的第一个 Android 应用
3 个学习路径 | 时长：10 小时
学习编程基础并创建你的第一个 Android 应用。
编写能够输出文本的简单 Kotlin 程序。
下载并安装 Android Studio。
构建一个带有简单用户界面（显示文本与图片）的 Android 应用。
在真机或模拟器上运行该应用。
  Kotlin 入门
  路径 1 | 时长：3 小时
  学习 Kotlin 的入门级编程概念。
  搭建 Android Studio
  路径 2 | 时长：4 小时
  安装并配置 Android Studio，创建你的第一个项目，并在真机或模拟器上运行。
  构建基础布局
  路径 3 | 时长：3 小时
  构建一个具有简单用户界面（显示文本与图片）的 Android 应用。
单元 2：构建应用 UI
3 个学习路径 | 时长：21 小时
继续学习 Kotlin 基础，并开始构建更具交互性的应用。
在 Kotlin 中使用条件语句、函数类型、类与 Lambda 表达式。
理解组合（Composition）与重组（Recomposition）的工作原理。
为应用 UI 添加按钮并响应用户的点击。
创建能够处理用户输入数据的应用。
学习如何使用状态（State）展示数据，并在数据更新时自动反映变化。
编写单元测试来测试独立的函数。
  Kotlin 进阶
  路径 1 | 时长：8 小时
  深入学习 Kotlin、面向对象编程以及 Lambda 表达式。
  为应用添加按钮
  路径 2 | 时长：6 小时
  学习如何响应 Android 应用中的按钮点击事件。
  与 UI 及状态交互
  路径 3 | 时长：7 小时
  创建一个根据用户输入计算小费的小费计算器应用。
单元 3：展示列表与使用 Material Design
3 个学习路径 | 时长：15 小时
构建能够展示数据列表的应用，并学习如何使用 Material Design 让应用更加美观。
在 Kotlin 中使用数据类、函数与集合。
在应用中创建可滚动的、同时显示文本与图片的列表。
为列表项添加点击监听器以实现交互。
为应用添加应用栏（App Bar），并修改主题样式。
使用 Material Design 的颜色、形状与排版构建现代、直观的用户界面。
  Kotlin 进阶补充
  路径 1 | 时长：8 小时
  学习额外的 Kotlin 编程概念，让你能够构建更有趣、更丰富的 Android 应用。
  构建可滚动列表
  路径 2 | 时长：4 小时
  使用 Compose 创建一个展示文本与图片的可滚动列表应用。
  打造精美的应用
  路径 3 | 时长：3 小时
  借助 Material Design、动画与无障碍最佳实践，让你的应用更美观、更易用。
单元 4：导航与应用架构
3 个学习路径 | 时长：28 小时
学习应用架构的最佳实践、如何实现页面导航，以及如何构建在任何屏幕尺寸上都拥有良好体验的自适应 UI。
理解 Activity 及其生命周期。
理解现代 Android 应用架构。
使用 StateFlow 与 UDF（单向数据流）模式处理状态与事件。
添加 ViewModel 来保存数据与状态。
配置并使用 Compose 中的 Navigation 组件。
学习自适应与响应式设计的原则。
使用 Window Size Class 为多种设备形态创建自适应布局。
为应用添加导航抽屉（Navigation Drawer）。
  架构组件
  路径 1 | 时长：9 小时
  学习应用架构，并使用 ViewModel、UI State 与 StateFlow 构建更复杂的应用。
  Jetpack Compose 中的导航
  路径 2 | 时长：6 小时
  学习如何使用 Navigation 组件构建包含多页面的复杂应用，并在不同 Composable 之间进行导航和数据传递。
  适配不同屏幕尺寸
  路径 3 | 时长：13 小时
  在本路径中，你将学习如何让应用适配不同的屏幕尺寸，提供更优的用户体验，以及如何测试自适应 UI。
单元 5：连接互联网
2 个学习路径 | 时长：9 小时
使用 Kotlin 协程同时执行多个任务，并学习 HTTP 与 REST，通过 Retrofit 从网络获取数据，再使用 Coil 库在应用中展示图片。
描述并发的基本概念以及如何在 Android 应用中使用协程。
定义并理解现代 Android 应用架构中的数据层（Data Layer）。
实现 Repository 以集中管理数据访问。
使用 Retrofit 从远程服务器获取数据。
使用 Coil 库加载并显示图片。
通过依赖注入实现类与类之间的解耦，使应用更易于测试、维护与扩展。
  从互联网获取数据
  路径 1 | 时长：6 小时
  使用协程实现并发任务而不阻塞应用，并学习通过 HTTP 与 REST 从网络获取数据。
  从网络加载并显示图片
  路径 2 | 时长：3 小时
  将架构最佳实践应用到项目中，并使用 Coil 下载和展示图片。
单元 6：数据持久化
3 个学习路径 | 时长：10 小时
学习如何将数据本地保存到设备，让你的应用在网络中断时仍能流畅、稳定地运行。
学习 SQL 基础，用于在 SQLite 数据库中插入、更新和删除数据。
使用 Room 库为 Android 应用添加数据库。
使用 Database Inspector 测试和调试数据库相关问题。
使用 Preference DataStore 存储用户偏好设置。
  SQL 入门
  路径 1 | 时长：2 小时
  学习如何使用 SQL 读取并操作关系型数据库中的数据。
  使用 Room 实现数据持久化
  继续学习如何使用 Room 与 DataStore 将数据本地持久化到设备上。`
        }
    },
    computed: {
        currentCourseName() {
            if (this.courseDetail && this.courseDetail.courseName) {
                return this.courseDetail.courseName;
            }
            if (this.$route.query.courseName) {
                return decodeURIComponent(this.$route.query.courseName);
            }
            return '课程详情';
        },
        resolvedCoverUrl() {
            if (!this.courseDetail) return '';
            const raw = this.courseDetail.coverUrl || this.courseDetail.cover_url;
            if (raw == null) return '';
            const url = String(raw).trim();
            if (!url) return '';
            if (url.startsWith('http:
                return url;
            }
            const base = (this.$store && this.$store.state && this.$store.state.baseApi) || '';
            if (url.startsWith('./')) {
                return base + '/resource/' + url.substring(2);
            }
            if (url.startsWith('/')) {
                return base + url;
            }
            return base + '/resource/' + url;
        },
        courseIntroText() {
            const d = this.courseDetail || {};
            const remote = d.intro || d.introduction || d.detail || d.detailIntro;
            if (remote && String(remote).trim()) {
                return String(remote);
            }
            return this.defaultIntroText;
        }
    },
    created() {
        this.userId = Number(Cookies.get('userId'));
        this.init();
    },
    beforeRouteEnter(to, from, next) {
        next(vm => {
            vm.init();
        });
    },
    methods: {
        init() {
            const courseId = this.$route.query.courseId;
            if (courseId) {
                this.mode = 'detail';
                this.fetchCourseDetail(courseId);
            } else {
                this.mode = 'list';
                this.fetchCourses();
            }
        },
        async fetchEnrolledClasses() {
            if (!this.userId) return;
            try {
                const res = await getUserClassList({ userId: this.userId });
                let list = [];
                if (res && res.data && res.data.code === 200 && Array.isArray(res.data.resultData)) {
                    list = res.data.resultData;
                } else if (res && res.data && res.data.code === 200 && Array.isArray(res.data.data)) {
                    list = res.data.data;
                }
                const classIdSet = new Set();
                list.forEach(item => {
                    const cId = item.classId;
                    if (cId != null) {
                        classIdSet.add(cId);
                    }
                });
                this.enrolledClasses = classIdSet;
            } catch (err) {
                console.warn('获取已选班级失败:', err);
            }
        },
        async fetchCourseDetail(id) {
            this.loading = true;
            this.courseDetail = null;
            this.classList = [];
            this.coverFailed = false;
            try {
                const res = await getCourseById(id);
                if (res && res.data && res.data.code === 200 && res.data.resultData) {
                    this.courseDetail = res.data.resultData;
                } else if (res && res.data && res.data.code === 200 && res.data.data) {
                    this.courseDetail = res.data.data;
                } else if (res && res.data && typeof res.data === 'object') {
                    this.courseDetail = res.data;
                } else {
                    console.warn('课程详情数据格式异常:', res);
                    this.courseDetail = null;
                }
                if (this.courseDetail) {
                    try {
                        const classRes = await getClassesByCourseId(id);
                        if (classRes && classRes.data && classRes.data.code === 200 && Array.isArray(classRes.data.resultData)) {
                            this.classList = classRes.data.resultData;
                        } else if (classRes && classRes.data && classRes.data.code === 200 && Array.isArray(classRes.data.data)) {
                            this.classList = classRes.data.data;
                        } else {
                            this.classList = [];
                        }
                    } catch (classErr) {
                        console.warn('获取关联班级失败:', classErr);
                        this.classList = [];
                    }
                    await this.fetchEnrolledClasses();
                }
            } catch (err) {
                console.error('获取课程详情异常:', err);
                this.courseDetail = null;
            } finally {
                this.loading = false;
            }
        },
        async fetchCourses() {
            this.loading = true;
            try {
                const res = await getAllCourses();
                if (res && res.data && res.data.code === 200 && Array.isArray(res.data.resultData)) {
                    this.courseList = res.data.resultData;
                } else if (res && res.data && res.data.code === 200 && Array.isArray(res.data.data)) {
                    this.courseList = res.data.data;
                } else if (res && Array.isArray(res)) {
                    this.courseList = res;
                } else if (res && res.data && Array.isArray(res.data)) {
                    this.courseList = res.data;
                } else {
                    console.warn('课程数据格式异常:', res);
                    this.courseList = [];
                }
            } catch (err) {
                console.error('获取课程列表异常:', err);
                this.courseList = [];
            } finally {
                this.loading = false;
            }
        },
        openCourseDetail(course) {
            this.$router.push({
                name: 'CourseDetail',
                query: { courseId: course.id, courseName: course.courseName || course.name }
            });
        },
        goBack() {
            if (window.history.length > 1) {
                this.$router.back();
            } else {
                this.$router.push('/home');
            }
        },
        async handleEnroll(cls) {
            const classId = cls.id || cls.classId;
            if (!this.userId || !classId) {
                this.$message.warning('无法获取用户或班级信息');
                return;
            }
            if (this.enrollingClassId === classId) return; 
            this.enrollingClassId = classId;
            try {
                const res = await enrollClass({ userId: this.userId, classId: classId });
                if (res && res.data && res.data.code === 200) {
                    this.$message.success('选课成功！');
                    this.enrolledClasses = new Set([...this.enrolledClasses, classId]);
                } else {
                    this.$message.error(res?.data?.msg || '选课失败，请重试');
                }
            } catch (err) {
                console.error('选课异常:', err);
                this.$message.error('选课请求异常');
            } finally {
                this.enrollingClassId = null;
            }
        },
        async handleUnenroll(cls) {
            const classId = cls.id || cls.classId;
            if (!this.userId || !classId) {
                this.$message.warning('无法获取用户或班级信息');
                return;
            }
            if (this.enrollingClassId === classId) return; 
            this.enrollingClassId = classId;
            try {
                const res = await unenrollClass({ userId: this.userId, classId: classId });
                if (res && res.data && res.data.code === 200) {
                    this.$message.success('退选成功');
                    const newSet = new Set(this.enrolledClasses);
                    newSet.delete(classId);
                    this.enrolledClasses = newSet;
                } else {
                    this.$message.error(res?.data?.msg || '退选失败，请重试');
                }
            } catch (err) {
                console.error('退选异常:', err);
                this.$message.error('退选请求异常');
            } finally {
                this.enrollingClassId = null;
            }
        }
    }
}
</script>
<style scoped>
.courses-container {
    padding: 24px;
    min-height: calc(100vh - 80px);
    background: #f0f2f5;
}
.page-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
}
.page-title {
    font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #1a1a2e;
    margin: 0;
}
.course-count {
    margin-left: 12px;
    font-size: 14px;
    color: #909399;
    background: #e8eaed;
    padding: 2px 12px;
    border-radius: 12px;
}
.loading-state {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 80px 0;
    color: #909399;
    font-size: 16px;
    gap: 10px;
}
.loading-state i {
    font-size: 24px;
}
.course-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(360px, 1fr));
    gap: 20px;
}
.course-card {
    background: #fff;
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 20px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    position: relative;
    border: 1px solid #ebeef5;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}
.course-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-4px);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    border-color: #409eff;
}
.card-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    justify-content: space-between;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.course-name {
    font-size: 18px;

```vue
<template>
    <div class="student-courses-container">
        <div class="page-header">
            <h1 class="page-title">📖 正在学习</h1>
            <span class="course-count">共 {{ courseList.length }} 门课程</span>
        </div>
        <!-- 加载状态 -->
        <div v-if="loading" class="loading-state">
            <i class="el-icon-loading"></i>
            <span>加载中...</span>
        </div>
        <!-- 已选课程列表 -->
        <div v-else-if="courseList.length > 0" class="course-grid">
            <div
                v-for="(item, index) in courseList"
                :key="index"
                class="course-card"
                style="cursor: pointer;"
                @click="goToLearning(item)"
            >
                <div class="card-cover">
                    <img
                        v-if="resolveCoverUrl(item) && !failedCoverMap[item.courseId || index]"
                        :src="resolveCoverUrl(item)"
                        :alt="item.courseName"
                        class="cover-img"
                        @error="onCoverError(item, index)"
                    />
                    <div
                        v-else
                        class="cover-fallback"
                        :style="{ background: getCoverColor(item.courseId || index) }"
                    >
                        <span class="cover-letter">{{ (item.courseName || '课').charAt(0).toUpperCase() }}</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="card-body">
                    <div class="card-title-row">
                        <h3 class="card-title">{{ item.courseName }}</h3>
                        <el-tag v-if="item.semester === 1" size="mini" type="success">春季</el-tag>
                        <el-tag v-else-if="item.semester === 2" size="mini" type="warning">秋季</el-tag>
                    </div>
                    <p class="card-desc">{{ item.description || '暂无课程描述' }}</p>
                    <div class="card-meta">
                        <div class="meta-item">
                            <i class="el-icon-s-home"></i>
                            <span>{{ item.className }}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="meta-item" v-if="item.academicYear">
                            <i class="el-icon-date"></i>
                            <span>{{ item.academicYear }}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="meta-item">
                            <i class="el-icon-user-solid"></i>
                            <span>{{ item.teacherName || '未指定教师' }}</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <!-- 空状态 -->
        <div v-else class="empty-state">
            <i class="el-icon-notebook-1 empty-icon"></i>
            <p class="empty-text">暂无正在学习的课程</p>
            <p class="empty-hint">前往课程广场选课后即可开始学习</p>
            <el-button type="primary" @click="goToCoursePlaza" class="go-btn">
                去选课
            </el-button>
        </div>
    </div>
</template>
<script>
import { getEnrolledCourses } from '@/api/studentweb/courses';
import Cookies from 'js-cookie';
export default {
    name: "StudentCourses",
    data() {
        return {
            courseList: [],
            loading: false,
            failedCoverMap: {}
        }
    },
    created() {
        this.fetchEnrolledCourses();
    },
    methods: {
        resolveCoverUrl(item) {
            if (!item) return ''
            const raw = item.coverUrl || item.cover_url
            if (raw == null) return ''
            const url = String(raw).trim()
            if (!url) return ''
            if (url.startsWith('http:
                return url
            }
            const base = (this.$store && this.$store.state && this.$store.state.baseApi) || ''
            if (url.startsWith('./')) {
                return base + '/resource/' + url.substring(2)
            }
            if (url.startsWith('/')) {
                return base + url
            }
            return base + '/resource/' + url
        },
        onCoverError(item, idx) {
            const key = (item && item.courseId != null) ? item.courseId : idx
            this.$set(this.failedCoverMap, key, true)
        },
        getCoverColor(id) {
            const colors = [
                'linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%)',
                'linear-gradient(135deg, #f093fb 0%, #f5576c 100%)',
                'linear-gradient(135deg, #4facfe 0%, #00f2fe 100%)',
                'linear-gradient(135deg, #43e97b 0%, #38f9d7 100%)',
                'linear-gradient(135deg, #fa709a 0%, #fee140 100%)',
                'linear-gradient(135deg, #a18cd1 0%, #fbc2eb 100%)'
            ]
            const key = String(id == null ? '' : id)
            let hash = 0
            for (let i = 0; i < key.length; i++) {
                hash = ((hash << 5) - hash) + key.charCodeAt(i)
            }
            return colors[Math.abs(hash) % colors.length]
        },
        async fetchEnrolledCourses() {
            const userId = Number(Cookies.get('userId'));
            if (!userId) {
                this.$message.warning('用户未登录');
                return;
            }
            this.loading = true;
            try {
                const res = await getEnrolledCourses(userId);
                if (res && res.code === 200 && Array.isArray(res.resultData)) {
                    this.courseList = res.resultData;
                } else if (res && res.data && res.data.code === 200 && Array.isArray(res.data.resultData)) {
                    this.courseList = res.data.resultData;
                } else {
                    this.courseList = [];
                }
            } catch (err) {
                console.error('获取已选课程异常:', err);
                this.courseList = [];
                this.$message.error('获取已选课程失败');
            } finally {
                this.loading = false;
            }
        },
        goToCoursePlaza() {
            this.$router.push({ name: 'studenthome' });
        },
        goToLearning(course) {
            if (!course.classId) {
                this.$message.warning('该课程未关联班级，无法进入学习');
                return;
            }
            this.$router.push({
                name: 'CourseLearning',
                query: {
                    courseId: course.courseId || course.id,
                    courseName: course.courseName,
                    classId: course.classId,
                    teacherName: course.teacherName || ''
                }
            });
        }
    }
}
</script>
<style scoped>
.student-courses-container {
    padding: 24px;
    min-height: calc(100vh - 80px);
    background: #f0f2f5;
}

}

}

}

<template>
    <div>
    <div class="avatar-section">
        <div class="avatar-display">

            </el-button>

            </template>

        </el-descriptions-item>
        <el-descriptions-item v-if="Info.sex==0">
            <template slot="label">
                <i class="el-icon-tickets"></i>
                性别
            </template>
            <el-tag size="small">男</el-tag>
        </el-descriptions-item>
        <el-descriptions-item v-if="Info.sex==1">
            <template slot="label">
                <i class="el-icon-tickets"></i>
                性别
            </template>
            <el-tag size="small">女</el-tag>
        </el-descriptions-item>
        <el-descriptions-item>
            <template slot="label">
                <i class="el-icon-office-building"></i>
                创建时间
            </template>
            {{Info.createTime}}
        </el-descriptions-item>
        <el-descriptions-item>
            <template slot="label">

                班级
            </template>
            {{Info.className || '未加入班级'}}
        </el-descriptions-item>
    </el-descriptions>
        <el-dialog title="修改个人信息" :visible.sync="dialogFormVisible">

                <el-form-item label="姓名" :label-width="formLabelWidth" prop="userName">
                    <el-input v-model="Info.userName" autocomplete="off"></el-input>
                </el-form-item>

                    <el-input v-model="Info.account" autocomplete="off" disabled></el-input>
                </el-form-item>

                <!--                </el-form-item>-->
                <el-form-item label="电话" :label-width="formLabelWidth" prop="phone">
                    <el-input v-model="Info.phone" autocomplete="off"></el-input>
